source.text: Παρῆσαν δέ τινες ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ ἀπαγγέλλοντες αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν Γαλιλαίων ὧν τὸ αἷμα Πιλᾶτος ἔμιξεν μετὰ τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Were present now some at the very time, telling him about the Galileans, of whom the blood Pilate mixed with the sacrifices of them.

en.L: Now at that very time some were present who told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
en.B: At that very time some people there told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mingled with the blood of their sacrifices.
en.R: Around that time some people told Jesus what had happened to some men from Galilee. Pilate had them killed while they were offering sacrifices to God. Their blood was mixed with the blood of the animals they were offering.

es.L: En ese mismo tiempo estaban allí algunos que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} informaban acerca de los galileos cuya sangre Pilato había mezclado con sus sacrificios.
es.B: En ese mismo momento, algunos de los que estaban allí le contaron a Jesús lo de los galileos cuya sangre Pilato había mezclado con la sangre de sus sacrificios.
es.R: Por esos días, algunas personas le contaron a Jesús lo que les había pasado a unos hombres de Galilea. Pilato los había mandado matar mientras ofrecían sacrificios a Dios. Su sangre se mezcló con la sangre de los animales que ofrecían.

fr.L: Or, en ce temps même, il y en avait là quelques-uns qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parlèrent des Galiléens dont Pilate avait mêlé le sang à leurs sacrifices.
fr.B: À ce moment même, des gens qui se trouvaient là racontèrent à Jésus ce qui était arrivé aux Galiléens dont Pilate avait mêlé le sang à celui de leurs sacrifices.
fr.R: À peu près à ce moment-là, des gens ont raconté à Jésus ce qui était arrivé à des hommes de Galilée. Pilate les avait fait tuer pendant qu’ils offraient des sacrifices à Dieu. Leur sang s’était mêlé au sang des animaux qu’ils offraient.

sw.L: Basi wakati uleule walikuwapo watu fulani waliokuwa wakimpasha habari za Wagalilaya ambao Pilato alikuwa amechanganya damu yao na dhabihu zao.
sw.B: Wakati huohuo baadhi ya watu waliokuwapo walimweleza Yesu habari za Wagalilaya ambao Pilato alikuwa amechanganya damu yao na damu ya dhabihu zao.
sw.R: Wakati huo watu fulani walimwambia Yesu yaliyowapata wanaume kadhaa kutoka Galilaya. Pilato alikuwa ameamuru wauawe walipokuwa wakimtolea Mungu dhabihu. Damu yao ilichanganyika na damu ya wanyama waliokuwa wakiwatoa sadaka.

ko.L: 바로 그때에 몇 사람이 거기 있다가, 빌라도가 그들의 피를 그들의 제물에 섞은 그 갈릴리 사람들에 대하여 그분께 알려 드렸다.
ko.B: 바로 그때에 거기 있던 몇 사람이 예수께, 빌라도가 갈릴리 사람들을 죽여 그 피를 그들이 바치던 제물의 피에 섞은 일을 알려 드렸다.
ko.R: 그 무렵에 몇 사람이 예수께 갈릴리 사람들에게 일어난 일을 알려 드렸다. 그 갈릴리 사람들이 하나님께 제물을 바치고 있을 때에 빌라도가 그들을 죽이게 했다. 그래서 그들의 피가 제물로 바치던 짐승의 피와 섞였다.

vi.L: Ngay lúc ấy có mấy người có mặt [ở đó] thuật lại cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về những người Ga-li-lê mà Phi-lát đã trộn máu họ với các của lễ của họ.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, có mấy người ở đó kể cho Đức Giê-xu nghe về những người Ga-li-lê mà Phi-lát đã trộn máu họ với máu các con sinh tế họ đang dâng.
vi.R: Khoảng thời gian đó, có mấy người kể cho Đức Giê-xu nghe chuyện đã xảy ra cho mấy người từ Ga-li-lê. Phi-lát đã cho giết họ trong lúc họ đang dâng của lễ cho Đức Chúa Trời. Máu họ hòa lẫn với máu các con vật họ đang dâng.

decisions.choice: whose blood Pilate mixed with their sacrifices: Pilate had them killed while they were offering their sacrifices
alternatives: Pilate mixed their blood into the offerings as an insult after their death
decisions.reason: The vivid phrase says that the men were killed at the very moment of worship, so that their blood ran together with the blood of the animals they had brought. Sacrifices were offered only at the temple in Jerusalem, so it happened there, probably at a festival.

decisions.choice: Pilate: the Roman governor of Judea
decisions.reason: Pontius Pilate governed Judea for Rome (3:1). This killing is not recorded anywhere else, though the Jewish historian Josephus tells of other times when Pilate's soldiers killed crowds.

decisions.choice: at that very time: while Jesus was still speaking the words of 12:54-59
decisions.reason: Luke ties the report to Jesus' warning about reading the times and settling accounts before judgment. Jesus' answer picks up that warning.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

decisions.choice: Pilate had them killed while they were offering sacrifices to God
alternatives: whose blood Pilate mixed with their sacrifices
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the blood.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Luke's historic presents kept as presents at Literal
decisions.reason: As in John and Mark: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school today. Jesus's words, the parables of 13:6-9 and 13:18-21 included, keep the tenses of speech at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: wakimpasha habari, with no span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a span on "Him". As through Luke, Swahili spans go only on free pronouns and possessives, never on verb prefixes (wakimpasha, aliwaambia), which cannot take a capital; so Swahili has fewer spans than English in this chapter.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Luke 13; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시-, Literal refers to him as "그분", Jesus speaks in 해라체 and people speak to him in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (Korean style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "갈릴리 사람들을 죽여" (B); "빌라도가 그들을 죽이게 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom of blood mixed with sacrifices means that Pilate had them killed while they were sacrificing (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Phi-lát"; "các của lễ" (L), "máu các con sinh tế" (B), "máu các con vật họ đang dâng" (R)
decisions.reason: The Protestant form of the name in the style guide's list. Literal keeps the bare word "sacrifices"; Balanced and Readable say that the blood of the animals offered is meant, as the English Balanced and Readable do.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Δοκεῖτε ὅτι οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι οὗτοι ἁμαρτωλοὶ παρὰ πάντας τοὺς Γαλιλαίους ἐγένοντο, ὅτι ταῦτα πεπόνθασιν;

records.literal_gloss: And answering he said to them, Do you think that these Galileans sinners beyond all the Galileans were, because these things they have suffered?

en.L: And answering, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Do you think that these Galileans were sinners beyond all the [other] Galileans, because they have suffered these things?
en.B: He answered them, "Do you suppose that these Galileans suffered this because they were worse sinners than all the other people of Galilee?
en.R: Jesus answered, "Do you think this happened to them because they were worse sinners than everyone else from Galilee?

es.L: Y respondiendo, les dijo: «¿{{plural_you:Piensan|Pensáis}} que estos galileos eran pecadores más que todos los [demás] galileos, porque han sufrido estas cosas?
es.B: Él les respondió: «¿{{plural_you:Suponen|Suponéis}} que estos galileos sufrieron esto porque eran más pecadores que todos los demás de Galilea?
es.R: Jesús les respondió: «¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que les pasó esto porque eran peores pecadores que todos los demás galileos?

fr.L: Et, prenant la parole, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Pensez-vous que ces Galiléens étaient des pécheurs plus que tous les [autres] Galiléens, parce qu’ils ont souffert cela ?
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Pensez-vous que ces Galiléens ont subi un tel sort parce qu’ils étaient plus pécheurs que tous les autres habitants de la Galilée ?
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Vous pensez que cela leur est arrivé parce qu’ils étaient de plus grands pécheurs que tous les autres gens de Galilée ?

sw.L: Naye akijibu, aliwaambia, "Je, mnadhani kwamba Wagalilaya hawa walikuwa wenye dhambi kuliko Wagalilaya wote [wengine], kwa sababu wamepatwa na mambo haya?
sw.B: Aliwajibu, "Je, mnadhani Wagalilaya hao walipatwa na hayo kwa sababu walikuwa wenye dhambi kuliko watu wengine wote wa Galilaya?
sw.R: Yesu aliwajibu, "Mnadhani mambo hayo yaliwapata kwa sababu walikuwa wenye dhambi zaidi kuliko watu wengine wote wa Galilaya?

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 대답하여 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이 갈릴리 사람들이 이런 일들을 당했으므로, 모든 [다른] 갈릴리 사람들보다 더 죄인이었다고 너희는 생각하느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 대답하셨다. "이 갈릴리 사람들이 이런 일을 당한 것은 다른 모든 갈릴리 사람보다 죄가 더 많았기 때문이라고 생각하느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "그 사람들이 그런 일을 당한 것이 다른 갈릴리 사람들보다 더 나쁜 죄인이었기 때문이라고 생각하느냐?

vi.L: Và đáp lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các người tưởng rằng những người Ga-li-lê này là những kẻ có tội hơn tất cả những người Ga-li-lê [khác], vì họ đã chịu những điều ấy sao?
vi.B: Ngài trả lời họ: "Các người tưởng rằng những người Ga-li-lê ấy phải chịu như vậy là vì họ tội lỗi hơn mọi người Ga-li-lê khác sao?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Các người nghĩ rằng chuyện ấy xảy ra cho họ vì họ tội lỗi hơn mọi người khác ở Ga-li-lê sao?

decisions.choice: sinners ... because they have suffered: the belief that a terrible death proves a person's special guilt
decisions.reason: Many assumed that great suffering was God's punishment for great sin (John 9:2; Job 4:7). Jesus raises the idea in order to reject it (13:3).

decisions.choice: beyond: more than, worse than
decisions.reason: With a comparison the word means "more than": were they greater sinners than all the rest?

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 13:5
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 13:2-5 are one answer.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Piensan|Pensáis}}
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the whole group, so every plural "you" takes the reader setting: "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) or "vosotros" (Spain). English has no such choice. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks to the people who brought the news as "các người", through 13:5
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to a crowd that is not his disciples, as in 7:9 and 7:24; the sentences are a warning, not teaching for his followers.

source.text: οὐχί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ’ ἐὰν μὴ μετανοῆτε πάντες ὁμοίως ἀπολεῖσθε.

records.literal_gloss: No, I say to you, but if not you repent, all likewise you will perish.

en.L: No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all perish likewise.
en.B: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you will all perish as they did.
en.R: No, I tell you. But if you do not turn away from your sins and turn to God, you will all be destroyed too.

es.L: No, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo; pero si no {{plural_you:se arrepienten|os arrepentís}}, todos {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}} de la misma manera.
es.B: No, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo. Pero si no {{plural_you:se arrepienten|os arrepentís}}, todos {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}} como ellos.
es.R: No, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo. Pero si no {{plural_you:dejan sus|dejáis vuestros}} pecados y {{plural_you:se vuelven|os volvéis}} a Dios, todos {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} destruidos también.

fr.L: Non, je vous le dis ; mais si vous ne vous repentez pas, vous périrez tous de même.
fr.B: Non, je vous le dis. Mais si vous ne vous repentez pas, vous périrez tous comme eux.
fr.R: Non, je vous le dis. Mais si vous ne vous détournez pas de vos péchés pour revenir à Dieu, vous serez tous détruits, vous aussi.

sw.L: La, nawaambia; ila msipotubu, nyote mtaangamia kwa namna ileile.
sw.B: Hapana, nawaambia. Lakini msipotubu, nyote mtaangamia kama wao.
sw.R: Hapana, nawaambia. Lakini msipoacha dhambi zenu na kumrudia Mungu, nyote mtaangamizwa pia.

ko.L: 아니다. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희도 회개하지 않으면, 모두 마찬가지로 망할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 그렇지 않다. 너희도 회개하지 않으면 모두 그들처럼 망할 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 그렇지 않다. 너희도 죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오지 않으면, 모두 그렇게 망하고 말 것이다.

vi.L: Không phải đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người; nhưng nếu các người không ăn năn, thì tất cả các người cũng sẽ bị hư mất như vậy.
vi.B: Không phải đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói cho các người biết. Nhưng nếu các người không ăn năn, thì tất cả các người cũng sẽ bị hư mất như họ vậy.
vi.R: Không phải đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói cho các người biết. Nhưng nếu các người không từ bỏ tội lỗi và quay về với Đức Chúa Trời, thì tất cả các người cũng sẽ bị hủy diệt như vậy.

decisions.choice: repent: turn from sin to God, a change of heart that changes the way one lives
decisions.reason: The word means a change of mind, and in Luke it means turning back to God (3:3, 8; 5:32).

decisions.choice: perish: be destroyed and lost under God's judgment
decisions.reason: Everyone dies, so Jesus is not warning only of death. To perish is to come to ruin before God (13:28).

decisions.choice: likewise: just as surely, and perhaps in a death like theirs
decisions.reason: The word can mean simply "you too" or "in the same way". Either way the warning is to the hearers: their own judgment is coming unless they repent.

decisions.choice: turn away from your sins and turn to God (R); repent (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says what repenting is, as at 3:3 and 5:32.

decisions.choice: arrepentirse (L, B); dejar los pecados y volverse a Dios (R)
decisions.reason: "Arrepentirse" is the word for repentance through Luke (meaning decision m1). Readable spells out the turn from sin to God, as the English Readable does. The same in verse 5.

decisions.choice: "vous repentez" (L, B); "vous détournez de vos péchés pour revenir à Dieu" (R)
decisions.reason: The New Testament term sheet: "se repentir" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says what repenting is, as the English Readable does. The same in 13:5.

decisions.choice: kutubu (L, B); kuacha dhambi na kumrudia Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Kutubu" is the word for repentance through Luke (meaning decision m1). Readable spells out the turn from sin to God, as the English Readable does. The same in verse 5.

decisions.choice: "회개하다" (L, B); "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오다" (R); "망하다" for perish at every level, in 13:3 and 13:5
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 5:32; "망하다" carries being destroyed and lost under judgment rather than simply dying.

decisions.choice: "ăn năn" (L, B), "từ bỏ tội lỗi và quay về với Đức Chúa Trời" (R); "bị hư mất" (L, B), "bị hủy diệt" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:32: "ăn năn" is the Protestant word for repentance, and Readable unfolds it. "hư mất" keeps the sense of being lost under God's judgment, not only dying (meaning decision); Readable says it plainly. Kept in 13:5.

source.text: ἢ ἐκεῖνοι οἱ δεκαοκτὼ ἐφ’ οὓς ἔπεσεν ὁ πύργος ἐν τῷ Σιλωὰμ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτούς, δοκεῖτε ὅτι αὐτοὶ ὀφειλέται ἐγένοντο παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ἰερουσαλήμ;

records.literal_gloss: Or those eighteen on whom fell the tower in Siloam and killed them, do you think that they debtors were beyond all the men dwelling in Jerusalem?

en.L: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, do you think that they were debtors beyond all the {{gender:people|men}} living in Jerusalem?
en.B: Or think of those eighteen who were killed when the tower at Siloam fell on them. Do you suppose they were more guilty than everyone else living in Jerusalem?
en.R: And what about the eighteen people who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them? Do you think they were worse than all the other people who lived in Jerusalem?

es.L: O aquellos dieciocho sobre los cuales cayó la torre en Siloé y los mató, ¿{{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} que ellos eran deudores más que {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}} que habitaban en Jerusalén?
es.B: O {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} en aquellos dieciocho que murieron cuando la torre de Siloé les cayó encima. ¿{{plural_you:Suponen|Suponéis}} que eran más culpables que todos los demás que vivían en Jerusalén?
es.R: ¿Y qué hay de las dieciocho personas que murieron cuando la torre de Siloé les cayó encima? ¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que eran peores que toda la demás gente que vivía en Jerusalén?

fr.L: Ou ces dix-huit sur lesquels est tombée la tour de Siloé, qui les a tués, pensez-vous qu’ils étaient débiteurs plus que tous les {{gender:humains|hommes}} qui habitent Jérusalem ?
fr.B: Ou bien pensez à ces dix-huit personnes que la tour de Siloé a tuées en tombant sur elles. Croyez-vous qu’elles étaient plus coupables que tous les autres habitants de Jérusalem ?
fr.R: Et les dix-huit personnes qui sont mortes quand la tour de Siloé leur est tombée dessus ? Vous pensez qu’elles étaient pires que tous les autres habitants de Jérusalem ?

sw.L: Au wale kumi na wanane ambao mnara ulioko Siloamu uliwaangukia ukawaua, mnadhani kwamba wao walikuwa wadeni kuliko watu wote wakaao Yerusalemu?
sw.B: Au fikirini wale kumi na wanane waliouawa mnara wa Siloamu ulipowaangukia. Mnadhani walikuwa na hatia zaidi kuliko watu wengine wote waliokaa Yerusalemu?
sw.R: Na je, wale watu kumi na wanane waliokufa mnara wa Siloamu ulipowaangukia? Mnadhani walikuwa wabaya kuliko watu wengine wote walioishi Yerusalemu?

ko.L: 또는 실로암에서 탑이 그들 위에 무너져 그들을 죽게 한 그 열여덟 사람, 그들이 예루살렘에 사는 모든 사람들보다 더 빚진 자들이었다고 너희는 생각하느냐?
ko.B: 또 실로암에 있던 탑이 무너져 깔려 죽은 그 열여덟 사람을 생각해 보아라. 그들이 예루살렘에 사는 다른 모든 사람보다 죄가 더 컸다고 생각하느냐?
ko.R: 실로암에 있던 탑이 무너져서 열여덟 사람이 깔려 죽은 일도 있었다. 그 사람들이 예루살렘에 사는 다른 사람들보다 더 나쁜 사람들이었다고 생각하느냐?

vi.L: Hoặc mười tám người bị tháp ở Si-lô-ê đổ xuống đè chết, các người tưởng rằng họ là những kẻ mắc nợ hơn tất cả mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem sao?
vi.B: Còn mười tám người bị chết khi tháp Si-lô-ê đổ xuống đè lên họ thì thế nào? Các người tưởng rằng họ có tội hơn mọi người khác sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem sao?
vi.R: Còn mười tám người chết khi cái tháp ở Si-lô-ê đổ xuống đè lên họ thì thế nào? Các người nghĩ rằng họ tệ hơn tất cả những người khác sống ở Giê-ru-sa-lem sao?

decisions.choice: the tower in Siloam: a tower near the pool of Siloam in the south of Jerusalem
alternatives: a tower in a village far from the city
decisions.reason: Siloam was the area around the pool fed by Hezekiah's tunnel (John 9:7). The collapse is not recorded elsewhere. Unlike the Galileans, these people died in an accident, not by anyone's cruelty.

decisions.choice: debtors: people guilty before God
decisions.reason: Sin is pictured as a debt owed to God, as in the Lord's Prayer (11:4).

decisions.choice: more guilty (B); worse (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture of debt means.

decisions.choice: think of
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the fronted phrase a verb and asks the question in a second sentence.

decisions.choice: watu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has "people|men". "Watu" already means people of either sex, so there is nothing for the setting to change; the same for "wake" in verse 15.

decisions.choice: a fig tree in a vineyard: fruit trees were often planted among the vines
alternatives: a fig tree standing on its own
decisions.reason: A vineyard was a well-tended plot. A fig tree there had good soil and care, and its owner had every reason to expect figs.

decisions.choice: looking for fruit and finding none: as God looked for fruit in his people
decisions.reason: The prophets pictured Israel as God's vineyard or fig tree, and God coming to look for fruit and finding none (Isaiah 5:1-7; Jeremiah 8:13; Micah 7:1).

decisions.choice: fruit: the way of life that shows true repentance
decisions.reason: John the Baptist used the same picture: trees without good fruit are cut down (3:8-9). The parable follows the call to repent (13:3, 5).

decisions.choice: figs
decisions.reason: Readable names the fruit of a fig tree. The picture is the same.

decisions.choice: the parable is one quotation from here to 13:9, with the speakers in it in single quotation marks
alternatives: no quotation marks around the parable
decisions.reason: Jesus is speaking, and the owner and the gardener speak inside his story.

decisions.choice: the parable told in the passé composé at every level ("est venu", "a dit")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The parable is Jesus's spoken words, and French speech tells past events in the passé composé, as the style guide asks; the passé simple would turn his telling into written narration. The same for 13:19 and 13:21.

decisions.reason: French "quelqu’un" renders the Greek pronoun exactly, so Literal needs no supplied noun where English supplies [man].

decisions.choice: three years: long enough to show that the tree will not bear
decisions.reason: A healthy fig tree bears within a few years. Three years of coming and finding nothing shows the owner's patience and that it is running out. The years are counted from when he began looking, so the tree may be older still.

decisions.choice: use up the ground: make the soil useless, taking space and goodness that another plant could use
decisions.reason: The verb means to make idle or useless. The tree is worse than fruitless: it keeps the ground from being used well.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: the man who tended the vineyard (B); the gardener (R)
decisions.reason: "Vinedresser" is no longer an everyday word.

decisions.choice: "le vigneron" (L, B); "l’homme qui s’occupait de sa vigne" (R)
decisions.reason: Unlike English "vinedresser", "vigneron" is an everyday French word, so Balanced keeps it; Readable says who he is for young readers.

decisions.choice: "Voici trois ans que"
decisions.reason: The French idiom "voici ... que" carries both the attention word and the length of time, so Literal keeps the Greek word without a separate "voici".

decisions.choice: "보라" (L) for idou, through Luke 13; not rendered as a word (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek attention word with the plain "보라"; Balanced and Readable carry its force in the sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The owner speaks to his worker in 해라체; the worker answers in 합쇼체 (13:8-9)

decisions.reason: Polite modern forms between an owner and the man who works his vineyard; the old master-to-servant "ta ... ngươi" would make the scene stiff.

decisions.choice: Sir: a worker's respectful address to the owner
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the Lord, but here a gardener speaks to the man who owns the vineyard.

decisions.choice: leave it: let it alone, spare it
decisions.reason: The verb can mean "forgive" (11:4), but here it means to leave the tree standing. It asks for one more year of patience.

decisions.choice: dig around it and put manure: extra care beyond what a fig tree usually needed
decisions.reason: Fig trees were not usually given such care. The gardener offers to do all that can be done before giving up.

decisions.choice: says: a present tense in a story about the past
decisions.reason: The present tense makes the scene vivid; it is told in the past at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: fertilizer
decisions.reason: Readable uses the more familiar word for what manure does.

decisions.choice: "Maître"
decisions.reason: A worker speaks to the owner (m1). "Maître" is the respectful French word for an employer; "Seigneur" would read as a prayer, and "Monsieur" is too modern for a vineyard owner.

decisions.choice: "주인님" for kyrie at every level; "말한다" (L) for the present tense
decisions.reason: Here kyrie is a worker's address to the owner (meaning decision), so it is not "주님"; Literal keeps Luke's present tense in the story.

decisions.choice: "Thưa ông" for the worker's "Sir"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says this is a worker's respectful address to the owner, not a word for God or Jesus.

decisions.choice: "nói" with no past marker (L)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps the historic present at Literal by leaving out "đã"; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past.

source.text: κἂν μὲν ποιήσῃ καρπὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον εἰ δὲ μήγε, ἐκκόψεις αὐτήν.

records.literal_gloss: and if indeed it makes fruit in the coming [time] — ; but if not, you will cut it down.

en.L: and if it bears fruit in the future, [well and good]; but if not, you will cut it down.'"
en.B: If after that it bears fruit next year, well and good. If it does not, you can have it cut down.'"
en.R: Maybe it will have figs next year. If it does not, then you can cut it down.'"

es.L: y si da fruto en lo venidero, [bien está]; y si no, la cortarás”».
es.B: Si después de eso da fruto el año próximo, bien. Y si no, podrás mandarla cortar”».
es.R: Tal vez el año que viene dé higos. Si no, entonces la puedes cortar”».

fr.L: et s’il porte du fruit à l’avenir, [ce sera bien] ; sinon, tu le couperas.” »
fr.B: Si ensuite il donne du fruit l’année prochaine, tant mieux. Sinon, tu pourras le faire couper.” »
fr.R: Il donnera peut-être des figues l’année prochaine. Sinon, tu pourras le couper.” »

sw.L: na ukizaa matunda baadaye, [vema]; la sivyo, utaukata.'"
sw.B: Ukizaa matunda mwaka ujao, vema; usipozaa, unaweza kuukata.'"
sw.R: Huenda utazaa tini mwaka ujao. Usipozaa, basi unaweza kuukata.'"

ko.L: 그리고 앞으로 열매를 맺으면 [좋겠지만], 그렇지 않으면 주인님께서 그것을 베어 버리실 것입니다.'"
ko.B: 그래서 내년에 열매를 맺으면 좋고, 그렇지 않으면 그때에 베어 버리셔도 됩니다.'"
ko.R: 내년에는 무화과가 열릴지도 모릅니다. 그래도 열매가 없으면, 그때 베어 버리셔도 됩니다.'"

vi.L: và nếu sau này nó ra trái, [thì tốt]; bằng không, ông sẽ chặt nó đi.'"
vi.B: Nếu sang năm nó ra trái thì tốt. Bằng không, ông hãy cho chặt nó đi.'"
vi.R: Có lẽ sang năm nó sẽ có trái. Nếu không, lúc ấy ông hãy chặt nó đi.'"

decisions.choice: if it bears fruit ... : the sentence breaks off, leaving "well and good" unsaid
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the first half unfinished, as people do in speech when the end is obvious.

decisions.choice: in the coming [time]: next year, the year that has been asked for
alternatives: at any time in the future
decisions.reason: The gardener has asked for "this year also" (13:8).

decisions.choice: you will cut it down: the owner will decide; the gardener does not refuse
decisions.reason: The gardener asks only for time. If the tree stays barren he leaves the final word to the owner.

decisions.choice: the parable ends without saying what happened: the time for repentance is real but limited
alternatives: the tree was spared for ever
decisions.reason: Jesus leaves the story open, like the warnings of 13:3 and 5. The hearers are the tree, given time to bear fruit.

decisions.choice: [well and good] (L); well and good (B); Maybe it will ... (R)
decisions.reason: The words left unsaid are supplied so the sentence can be followed; Literal puts them in brackets.

decisions.choice: you can cut it down
decisions.reason: The future here gives permission. Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "[좋겠지만]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek sentence breaks off after the condition (meaning decision); Korean needs the unsaid words, bracketed.

source.text: Ἦν δὲ διδάσκων ἐν μιᾷ τῶν συναγωγῶν ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν.

records.literal_gloss: He was now teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbaths.

en.L: Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath.
en.B: Once, on a Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in one of the local synagogues.
en.R: One Sabbath day Jesus was teaching in a synagogue.

es.L: Y estaba enseñando en una de las sinagogas en sábado.
es.B: Un sábado, Jesús estaba enseñando en una de las sinagogas del lugar.
es.R: Un sábado Jesús estaba enseñando en una sinagoga.

fr.L: Or {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait dans une des synagogues le jour du sabbat.
fr.B: Un jour de sabbat, Jésus enseignait dans l’une des synagogues de la région.
fr.R: Un jour de sabbat, Jésus enseignait dans une synagogue.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akifundisha katika mojawapo ya masinagogi siku ya Sabato.
sw.B: Siku moja ya Sabato, Yesu alikuwa akifundisha katika mojawapo ya masinagogi ya mahali pale.
sw.R: Siku moja ya Sabato Yesu alikuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi.

ko.L: 그분이 안식일에 회당들 가운데 한 곳에서 가르치고 계셨다.
ko.B: 어느 안식일에 예수께서 한 회당에서 가르치고 계셨다.
ko.R: 어느 안식일에 예수께서 한 회당에서 사람들을 가르치고 계셨다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang giảng dạy trong một nhà hội kia vào ngày Sa-bát.
vi.B: Một lần, vào ngày Sa-bát, Đức Giê-xu đang giảng dạy trong một nhà hội ở địa phương.
vi.R: Vào một ngày Sa-bát, Đức Giê-xu đang dạy dỗ trong một nhà hội.

decisions.choice: on the Sabbaths: on a Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The plural is the usual way to name the Sabbath day (4:16).

decisions.choice: synagogues: local meeting places for prayer and the reading and teaching of Scripture
decisions.reason: This is the last time Luke shows Jesus teaching in a synagogue (4:15-16, 44; 6:6).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

decisions.choice: "le jour du sabbat", "un jour de sabbat" (lowercase "sabbat")
decisions.reason: The New Testament term sheet: "sabbat" is a common noun in French and takes no capital. The Greek plural names the day, so French says "le jour du sabbat", as in Mark.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ πνεῦμα ἔχουσα ἀσθενείας ἔτη δεκαοκτώ, καὶ ἦν συγκύπτουσα καὶ μὴ δυναμένη ἀνακύψαι εἰς τὸ παντελές.

records.literal_gloss: And look, a woman a spirit having of weakness years eighteen, and was bent over and not able to straighten up completely.

en.L: And look, [there was] a woman who had had a spirit of weakness for eighteen years, and she was bent over and was not able to straighten up at all.
en.B: A woman was there whom a spirit had kept sick for eighteen years. Her back was bent, and she could not stand fully upright.
en.R: A woman was there who had been sick for eighteen years because of a spirit that made her ill. Her back was bent over, and she could not stand up straight at all.

es.L: Y mira, [había] una mujer que tenía un espíritu de enfermedad [desde hacía] dieciocho años, y estaba encorvada y no podía enderezarse del todo.
es.B: Había allí una mujer a la que un espíritu tenía enferma desde hacía dieciocho años. Andaba encorvada y no podía ponerse derecha del todo.
es.R: Allí había una mujer que llevaba dieciocho años enferma por culpa de un espíritu. Tenía la espalda doblada y no podía enderezarse para nada.

fr.L: Et voici, [il y avait] une femme qui avait un esprit de faiblesse depuis dix-huit ans ; elle était courbée et ne pouvait pas du tout se redresser.
fr.B: Il y avait là une femme qu’un esprit rendait malade depuis dix-huit ans. Elle avait le dos courbé et ne pouvait pas se tenir tout à fait droite.
fr.R: Il y avait là une femme qui était malade depuis dix-huit ans à cause d’un esprit. Son dos était courbé, et elle ne pouvait pas du tout se tenir droite.

sw.L: Na tazama, [palikuwa na] mwanamke aliyekuwa na pepo wa udhaifu miaka kumi na minane, naye alikuwa amepinda, wala hakuweza kujinyoosha kabisa.
sw.B: Palikuwa na mwanamke ambaye pepo alikuwa amemfanya mgonjwa kwa miaka kumi na minane. Mgongo wake ulikuwa umepinda, wala hakuweza kusimama wima kabisa.
sw.R: Palikuwa na mwanamke aliyekuwa mgonjwa kwa miaka kumi na minane kwa sababu ya pepo aliyemletea ugonjwa. Mgongo wake ulikuwa umepinda, wala hakuweza kusimama wima hata kidogo.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 열여덟 해 동안 병약함의 영을 지니고 있는 한 여자가 [있었다]. 그 여자는 허리가 굽어 있어서, 몸을 조금도 펼 수 없었다.
ko.B: 거기에 한 여자가 있었는데, 어떤 영에 붙들려 열여덟 해 동안 병을 앓고 있었다. 그 여자는 허리가 굽어서 몸을 조금도 펼 수 없었다.
ko.R: 거기에 열여덟 해 동안 아파 온 여자가 있었다. 어떤 영이 그 여자를 병들게 했던 것이다. 그 여자는 허리가 굽어서 똑바로 설 수가 전혀 없었다.

vi.L: Và kìa, [có] một người phụ nữ có một linh gây bệnh tật đã mười tám năm; bà bị còng lưng và hoàn toàn không thể đứng thẳng lên được.
vi.B: Ở đó có một người phụ nữ bị một linh làm cho đau yếu đã mười tám năm. Lưng bà còng xuống, không sao đứng thẳng lên được.
vi.R: Ở đó có một bà đã bị bệnh suốt mười tám năm vì một linh làm cho bà đau yếu. Lưng bà bị còng xuống, và bà hoàn toàn không đứng thẳng lên được.

decisions.choice: a spirit of weakness: a spirit that caused her illness
alternatives: a weak or discouraged spirit in herself
decisions.reason: Jesus says that Satan had bound her (13:16). Luke tells of an evil power behind the sickness, though he does not call it a demon or show it being driven out.

decisions.choice: completely: goes with "not able": she could not straighten up at all
alternatives: she could not straighten up fully, only part of the way
decisions.reason: The phrase can go with the verb ("straighten up completely") or with the negative ("not ... at all"). Either way she lived bent over.

decisions.choice: eighteen years: a long time of suffering, the number Jesus repeats in 13:16
decisions.reason: The same number is given for the tower at Siloam (13:4), but there is no link between the two.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: the spirit made her sick (B); sick because of a spirit that made her ill (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "spirit of weakness" means.

decisions.choice: mira (L); left out (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word draws attention to what follows. Literal keeps it as "mira"; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does. The same through this chapter; where Jesus says it to a group it is plural (verse 30).

decisions.choice: pepo
decisions.reason: The spirit caused her illness (meaning decision m1), and Jesus says in verse 16 that Satan had bound her. "Pepo" names such a spirit; "roho" would sound neutral or even like the Holy Spirit.

decisions.choice: "병약함의 영" (L); "어떤 영에 붙들려 ... 병을 앓다" (B); "어떤 영이 ... 병들게 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the genitive; Balanced and Readable say that a spirit caused her illness (meaning decision) without calling it a demon, which the Greek does not.

decisions.choice: "một linh" at every level
decisions.reason: Luke calls it "a spirit of weakness", not an unclean spirit; "tà linh", which Readable uses for unclean spirits, would add what the Greek does not say here, although 13:16 says that Satan bound her.

source.text: ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὴν ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσεφώνησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Γύναι, ἀπολέλυσαι τῆς ἀσθενείας σου, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτῇ τὰς χεῖρας· καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνωρθώθη, καὶ ἐδόξαζεν τὸν θεόν.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then her Jesus called and said to her, Woman, you have been freed from the weakness of you, \v 13 and he laid on her the hands; and immediately she was made straight, and was glorifying God.

en.L: And seeing her, Jesus called [her] and said to her, "Woman, you have been set free from your weakness." \v 13 And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] hands on her, and at once she was made straight, and she began glorifying God.
en.B: When Jesus saw her, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called her over and told her, "Woman, you have been released from your illness." \v 13 Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} placed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands on her, and right away she stood up straight and began to give glory to God.
en.R: Jesus saw her and called her over to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He said, "Woman, you are free from your sickness." \v 13 He put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands on her, and right away she was able to stand up straight. She began to give glory to God.

es.L: Y viéndola, Jesús [la] llamó y le dijo: «Mujer, has sido liberada de tu enfermedad». \v 13 Y le impuso las manos, y al instante fue enderezada, y glorificaba a Dios.
es.B: Cuando Jesús la vio, la llamó y le dijo: «Mujer, has quedado libre de tu enfermedad». \v 13 Luego puso {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos sobre ella, y enseguida ella se enderezó y comenzó a dar gloria a Dios.
es.R: Jesús la vio y la llamó para que se acercara a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Le dijo: «Mujer, ya estás libre de tu enfermedad». \v 13 Puso {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos sobre ella, y enseguida ella pudo enderezarse. Comenzó a dar gloria a Dios.

fr.L: Et, la voyant, Jésus l’appela et lui dit : « Femme, tu es délivrée de ta faiblesse. » \v 13 Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} posa les mains sur elle, et aussitôt elle fut redressée, et elle glorifiait Dieu.
fr.B: Quand Jésus la vit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’appela et lui dit : « Femme, te voilà libérée de ta maladie. » \v 13 Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} posa les mains sur elle ; aussitôt elle se redressa, et elle se mit à rendre gloire à Dieu.
fr.R: Jésus l’a vue et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a appelée près de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il lui a dit : « Femme, tu es libérée de ta maladie. » \v 13 Il a posé les mains sur elle, et tout de suite elle a pu se tenir droite. Elle s’est mise à rendre gloire à Dieu.

sw.L: Naye Yesu alipomwona, alimwita, akamwambia, "Mama, umefunguliwa kutoka katika udhaifu wako." \v 13 Akaweka mikono [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}] juu yake; na mara akanyooshwa, akawa akimtukuza Mungu.
sw.B: Yesu alipomwona, alimwita, akamwambia, "Mama, umefunguliwa kutoka katika ugonjwa wako." \v 13 Kisha akaweka mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yake, na mara moja akasimama wima, akaanza kumtukuza Mungu.
sw.R: Yesu alimwona, akamwita aje {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Akamwambia, "Mama, uko huru kutoka katika ugonjwa wako." \v 13 Akaweka mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yake, na mara moja aliweza kusimama wima. Akaanza kumtukuza Mungu.

ko.L: 그런데 예수께서 그 여자를 보시고 불러서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "여자여, 너는 네 병약함에서 풀려났다." \v 13 그리고 그 여자에게 [그분의] 손을 얹으셨다. 그러자 그 여자가 곧 똑바로 펴졌고, 하나님께 영광을 돌리기 시작했다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그 여자를 보시고 가까이 부르셔서 말씀하셨다. "여인이여, 너는 병에서 풀려났다." \v 13 그리고 그 여자에게 손을 얹으시니, 그 여자가 곧바로 허리를 펴고 하나님께 영광을 돌렸다.
ko.R: 예수께서 그 여자를 보시고 가까이 부르셨다. 그리고 말씀하셨다. "여인이여, 이제 너는 병에서 놓여났다." \v 13 예수께서 그 여자에게 손을 얹으셨다. 그러자 그 여자는 바로 허리를 펴고 똑바로 섰다. 그리고 하나님께 영광을 돌리기 시작했다.

vi.L: Thấy bà, Đức Giê-xu gọi [bà] và nói với bà: "Hỡi bà, bà đã được giải thoát khỏi bệnh tật của mình." \v 13 Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt tay trên bà, tức thì bà được đứng thẳng lên, và bà tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Khi thấy bà, Đức Giê-xu gọi bà đến và nói: "Này bà, bà đã được giải thoát khỏi bệnh tật rồi." \v 13 Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt tay trên bà, và lập tức bà đứng thẳng lên được và bắt đầu tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu thấy bà và gọi bà đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài nói: "Bà ơi, bà đã được giải thoát khỏi bệnh rồi." \v 13 Ngài đặt tay trên bà, và ngay lúc ấy bà đứng thẳng lên được. Bà bắt đầu ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời.

decisions.choice: you have been set free: the release is already done, and God is the one who has done it
decisions.reason: The perfect tense speaks of a finished act, said even before Jesus touches her. The passive points to God. The same root word is used for untying an animal and for freeing her in 13:15-16.

decisions.choice: Woman: a polite form of address
alternatives: a cold or harsh way of speaking
decisions.reason: It was a normal and respectful way to speak to a woman (John 2:4; 4:21).

decisions.choice: she was glorifying: she began to praise God, and kept on
decisions.reason: The tense pictures praise that started at once and went on.

decisions.choice: began to give glory to God
decisions.reason: Glorify is a key term; Balanced and Readable keep "glory" in an everyday phrase.

decisions.choice: [his] hands
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the hands"; Literal supplies the owner in brackets.

decisions.choice: le impuso las manos, with no span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has spans on "He" and "[His]". Spanish leaves the subject in the verb and says "le impuso las manos" with no possessive, as the Greek has only "the hands", so Literal has no span here; Balanced and Readable keep theirs on "sus" and "él".

decisions.choice: "les mains", with no possessive
alternatives: "ses mains" with a pronoun span (B, R)
decisions.reason: French says "poser les mains sur quelqu’un" with the article, as the Greek does, so nothing is supplied and no pronoun span is needed where the English has "his".

decisions.choice: Mama
decisions.reason: As in John 2:4: the Greek is a polite address (meaning decision m2), but a man calling a woman "Mwanamke!" to her face is rude in Swahili, while "Mama" is the respectful address to an older woman.

decisions.choice: "여자여" (L); "여인이여" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide gives for Gynai: the plain word at Literal, a more respectful address at Balanced and Readable, since the word is polite (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for parachrēma; "하나님께 영광을 돌리다" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 5:25; the glory word is kept at Readable too, as the English keeps "give glory".

decisions.choice: "Hỡi bà" (L), "Này bà" (B), "Bà ơi" (R), and "bà" for "you"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says "Woman" is a polite address; Vietnamese makes it polite with the word for an older woman, as in Matthew 15:28. She has been ill for eighteen years.

decisions.choice: "tôn vinh" (L, B); "ngợi khen" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:25: "tôn vinh" is the word for glorify; Readable uses the everyday word for praising God.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἀρχισυνάγωγος, ἀγανακτῶν ὅτι τῷ σαββάτῳ ἐθεράπευσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἔλεγεν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὅτι Ἓξ ἡμέραι εἰσὶν ἐν αἷς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι· ἐν αὐταῖς οὖν ἐρχόμενοι θεραπεύεσθε καὶ μὴ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου.

records.literal_gloss: Answering then the synagogue ruler, being indignant that on the Sabbath had healed Jesus, was saying to the crowd that, Six days there are in which it is necessary to work; in them therefore coming be healed, and not on the day of the Sabbath.

en.L: But the ruler of the synagogue, indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, answered and was saying to the crowd, "There are six days in which [people] must work; so come on them and be healed, and not on the day of the Sabbath."
en.B: But the ruler of the synagogue was annoyed that Jesus had healed someone on the Sabbath, and he spoke up and told the crowd, "Work may be done on six days. Come to be healed on any of them, but not on the Sabbath day."
en.R: The leader of the synagogue was angry because Jesus had healed someone on the Sabbath day. He said to the people, "God's law gives us six days to work. Come and get healed on one of those days. Do not come on the Sabbath!"

es.L: Pero respondiendo el jefe de la sinagoga, indignado porque Jesús había sanado en sábado, decía a la multitud: «Hay seis días en los que se debe trabajar; así que {{plural_you:vengan a curarse|venid a curaros}} en esos [días], y no en el día del sábado».
es.B: Pero el jefe de la sinagoga, molesto porque Jesús había sanado a alguien en sábado, tomó la palabra y dijo a la gente: «Hay seis días en que se puede trabajar. {{plural_you:Vengan a curarse|Venid a curaros}} en cualquiera de ellos, pero no el día de sábado».
es.R: El jefe de la sinagoga se enojó porque Jesús había sanado a alguien en sábado. Le dijo a la gente: «La ley de Dios nos da seis días para trabajar. {{plural_you:Vengan a curarse|Venid a curaros}} en uno de esos días. ¡No {{plural_you:vengan|vengáis}} en sábado!».

fr.L: Mais, prenant la parole, le chef de la synagogue, indigné de ce que Jésus avait guéri le jour du sabbat, disait à la foule : « Il y a six jours pendant lesquels il faut travailler ; venez donc ces jours-là vous faire guérir, et non le jour du sabbat. »
fr.B: Mais le chef de la synagogue, irrité de voir que Jésus avait fait une guérison le jour du sabbat, prit la parole et dit à la foule : « On peut travailler six jours. Venez donc vous faire guérir l’un de ces jours-là, mais pas le jour du sabbat. »
fr.R: Le responsable de la synagogue était en colère parce que Jésus avait guéri quelqu’un le jour du sabbat. Il a dit aux gens : « La Loi de Dieu nous donne six jours pour travailler. Venez vous faire guérir pendant ces jours-là. Ne venez pas le jour du sabbat ! »

sw.L: Lakini mkuu wa sinagogi, akijibu, akiwa amekasirika kwa sababu Yesu aliponya siku ya Sabato, alikuwa akiuambia umati, "Zipo siku sita ambazo inapasa kufanya kazi; kwa hiyo, mkija katika siku hizo, ponyweni, na si siku ya Sabato."
sw.B: Lakini kiongozi wa sinagogi alikasirika kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amemponya mtu siku ya Sabato. Akasimama akauambia umati, "Kazi inaweza kufanywa siku sita. Njooni mponywe siku yoyote kati ya hizo, lakini si siku ya Sabato."
sw.R: Kiongozi wa sinagogi alikasirika kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amemponya mtu siku ya Sabato. Aliwaambia watu, "Sheria ya Mungu inatupa siku sita za kufanya kazi. Njooni mponywe katika mojawapo ya siku hizo. Msije siku ya Sabato!"

ko.L: 그러나 회당장은 예수께서 안식일에 [병을] 고치셨으므로 분개하여, 대답하여 무리에게 말하고 있었다. "일해야 하는 날이 엿새가 있다. 그러므로 그날들에 와서 고침을 받고, 안식일에는 [그러지] 마라."
ko.B: 그러나 회당장은 예수께서 안식일에 병을 고치신 것에 분개하여 무리에게 말했다. "일할 날은 엿새가 있다. 그러니 그 엿새 동안에 와서 고침을 받고, 안식일에는 오지 마라."
ko.R: 그러나 회당을 이끄는 지도자는 예수께서 안식일에 병을 고치셨기 때문에 화가 났다. 그는 사람들에게 말했다. "하나님의 율법에 따르면 일하는 날은 엿새이다. 그 엿새 가운데 아무 날에나 와서 병을 고쳐라. 안식일에는 오지 마라!"

vi.L: Nhưng người lãnh đạo nhà hội, tức giận vì Đức Giê-xu đã chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát, lên tiếng nói với đám đông: "Có sáu ngày phải làm việc; vậy hãy đến trong những ngày ấy mà được chữa bệnh, chứ đừng [đến] trong ngày Sa-bát."
vi.B: Nhưng người lãnh đạo nhà hội bực tức vì Đức Giê-xu đã chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát, nên lên tiếng nói với dân chúng: "Có sáu ngày để làm việc. Hãy đến mà chữa bệnh trong những ngày ấy, đừng đến vào ngày Sa-bát."
vi.R: Người lãnh đạo nhà hội rất giận vì Đức Giê-xu đã chữa bệnh vào ngày Sa-bát. Ông nói với dân chúng: "Luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời cho chúng ta sáu ngày để làm việc. Hãy đến chữa bệnh vào một trong những ngày ấy. Đừng đến vào ngày Sa-bát!"

decisions.choice: six days ... to work: the words of the Sabbath commandment
decisions.reason: The law says that work is to be done in six days and the seventh is a Sabbath for the Lord (Exodus 20:9-10; Deuteronomy 5:13-14). The ruler treats healing as work.

decisions.choice: healing as work: treating an illness that was not life-threatening could wait until the Sabbath was over
alternatives: all healing was banned in every case
decisions.reason: Jewish teaching allowed the Sabbath to be set aside to save a life. A woman sick for eighteen years, the ruler implies, could wait one more day.

decisions.choice: was saying to the crowd: the ruler rebukes Jesus by speaking to the people
decisions.reason: He does not address Jesus directly. Jesus' answer is addressed to him (13:15).

decisions.choice: ruler of the synagogue: the leader in charge of the synagogue's meetings
decisions.reason: As at 8:41, he arranged the services and chose who would read and teach.

decisions.choice: leader of the synagogue
decisions.reason: Readable uses a more familiar word, as at 8:41.

decisions.choice: God's law gives us
alternatives: there are six days in which one must work
decisions.reason: Readable says where the rule comes from (Exodus 20:9).

decisions.choice: mkuu wa sinagogi (L); kiongozi wa sinagogi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The man in charge of the synagogue's meetings (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps the title "mkuu"; Balanced and Readable say "kiongozi", the leader, as the term is used through Luke.

decisions.choice: "회당장" (L, B); "회당을 이끄는 지도자" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 8:41.

decisions.choice: The ruler speaks to the crowd in 해라체; Jesus is honoured with -시- in the narrative but not in his words
decisions.reason: He rebukes Jesus by addressing the people (meaning decision); the plain style suits a leader's public order.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo nhà hội" at every level
decisions.reason: As in 8:41 and Mark 5:22.

source.text: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος καὶ εἶπεν· Ὑποκριταί, ἕκαστος ὑμῶν τῷ σαββάτῳ οὐ λύει τὸν βοῦν αὐτοῦ ἢ τὸν ὄνον ἀπὸ τῆς φάτνης καὶ ἀπαγαγὼν ποτίζει;

records.literal_gloss: Answered then him the Lord and said, Hypocrites, each of you on the Sabbath not unties the ox of him or the donkey from the manger and having led [it] away gives drink?

en.L: But the Lord answered him and said, "Hypocrites! Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie {{gender:their|his}} ox or donkey from the manger and lead [it] away to give [it] drink?
en.B: The Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! On the Sabbath every one of you unties your ox or your donkey from its stall and takes it out for water, do you not?
en.R: The Lord Jesus answered him, "You are pretending! On the Sabbath day every one of you unties your ox or your donkey. You lead it out of its stall so it can drink water.

es.L: Pero el Señor le respondió y dijo: «¡Hipócritas! ¿No desata cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en sábado su buey o su asno del pesebre, y lo lleva a beber?
es.B: El Señor le respondió: «¡Hipócritas! Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} desata en sábado su buey o su burro del establo y lo lleva a tomar agua, ¿no es así?
es.R: El Señor Jesús le respondió: «¡{{plural_you:Ustedes solo fingen|Vosotros solo fingís}}! En sábado cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} desata su buey o su burro. Lo saca del establo para que pueda beber agua.

fr.L: Mais le Seigneur lui répondit et dit : « Hypocrites ! Chacun de vous, le jour du sabbat, ne détache-t-il pas de la mangeoire son bœuf ou son âne, et ne l’emmène-t-il pas boire ?
fr.B: Le Seigneur lui répondit : « Hypocrites ! Le jour du sabbat, chacun de vous détache bien son bœuf ou son âne de l’étable pour le mener boire, n’est-ce pas ?
fr.R: Le Seigneur Jésus lui a répondu : « Vous jouez la comédie ! Le jour du sabbat, chacun de vous détache son bœuf ou son âne. Vous le faites sortir de l’étable pour qu’il aille boire.

sw.L: Lakini Bwana alimjibu, akasema, "Wanafiki! Je, kila mmoja wenu siku ya Sabato hamfungui ng'ombe wake au punda wake kutoka horini na kumpeleka akamnyweshe?
sw.B: Bwana alimjibu, "Ninyi wanafiki! Kila mmoja wenu siku ya Sabato humfungua ng'ombe wake au punda wake kutoka zizini na kumpeleka akanywe maji, sivyo?
sw.R: Bwana Yesu alimjibu, "Mnajifanya tu! Siku ya Sabato kila mmoja wenu humfungua ng'ombe wake au punda wake. Humtoa zizini ili akanywe maji.

ko.L: 그러자 주님께서 그에게 대답하여 말씀하셨다. "위선자들아, 너희는 각자 안식일에 자기 소나 나귀를 구유에서 풀어 끌고 가서 물을 먹이지 않느냐?
ko.B: 주님께서 그에게 대답하셨다. "위선자들아! 너희는 누구나 안식일에도 자기 소나 나귀를 외양간에서 풀어 끌고 가서 물을 먹이지 않느냐?
ko.R: 주 예수께서 그에게 대답하셨다. "너희 위선자들아! 너희는 누구나 안식일에도 자기 소나 나귀를 풀어 준다. 그리고 외양간에서 끌고 나가 물을 먹인다.

vi.L: Nhưng Chúa đáp lời ông và nói: "Hỡi những kẻ đạo đức giả! Chẳng phải mỗi người trong các người, vào ngày Sa-bát, đều mở dây con bò hay con lừa của mình khỏi máng cỏ mà dắt đi cho uống nước sao?
vi.B: Chúa đáp lời ông: "Hỡi những kẻ đạo đức giả! Vào ngày Sa-bát, ai trong các người cũng mở dây cho bò hay lừa của mình ra khỏi chuồng mà dắt đi uống nước, phải không?
vi.R: Chúa Giê-xu trả lời ông: "Các người thật là những kẻ đạo đức giả! Vào ngày Sa-bát, ai trong các người cũng mở dây cho con bò hay con lừa của mình. Các người dắt nó ra khỏi chuồng để cho nó uống nước.

decisions.choice: the Lord: Luke the narrator calls Jesus by his title
decisions.reason: As at 7:13 and 12:42, Luke uses the title for Jesus as he tells the story.

decisions.choice: hypocrites: people playing a part, whose words do not match their own practice
decisions.reason: The ruler and those who agree with him (13:17) apply the Sabbath strictly to this woman but not to their own animals (12:1, 56).

decisions.choice: untying an animal and leading it to water on the Sabbath: something everyone did
decisions.reason: Jesus' question assumes that his hearers all did this. An animal could not go without water for a day.

decisions.choice: manger: the feeding place, the stall where the animal was tied
decisions.reason: It is the same word as in 2:7, where it means a feeding trough.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus, as at 7:13.

decisions.choice: You are pretending!
decisions.reason: Readable says what hypocrisy is, as at 12:56.

decisions.choice: a statement (R), or a statement with a question added (B)
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "yes". Balanced and Readable state it.

decisions.choice: su buey, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has "their|his". Spanish "su" already serves for a man or a woman, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "Chacun de vous ... son bœuf"
decisions.reason: English Literal puts "their|his" under the gender setting. In French "chacun" and the possessive that refers back to it are ordinary generic French and already include everyone, so the style guide adds no span.

decisions.choice: "Vous jouez la comédie !"
decisions.reason: Readable says what hypocrisy is, as the English Readable does; "jouer la comédie" is the everyday French idiom for acting a part.

decisions.choice: "주님께서" (L, B), "주 예수께서" (R) for the narrator's "the Lord"; "위선자" at every level; "자기" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 7:13 and 10:1 and Matthew 6:2. Korean "자기" serves for men and women, so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "구유" (L); "외양간" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The manger is the feeding place where the animal was tied (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable name the stall.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ đạo đức giả" at every level; Readable "Các người thật là những kẻ đạo đức giả!"
decisions.reason: The settled word for hypocrites, as in 6:42 and Matthew; Vietnamese readers know "đạo đức giả" as people whose life does not match what they preach, which is the meaning decision's sense, so Readable keeps it.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for the narrator's "the Lord" ("Chúa Giê-xu" at R); "mở dây" for untying, repeated as "mở" in 13:16
decisions.reason: Luke the narrator gives Jesus his title (meaning decision). The same Vietnamese verb for untying the ox and freeing the woman keeps Jesus' argument visible.

source.text: ταύτην δὲ θυγατέρα Ἀβραὰμ οὖσαν, ἣν ἔδησεν ὁ Σατανᾶς ἰδοὺ δέκα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη, οὐκ ἔδει λυθῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ δεσμοῦ τούτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου;

records.literal_gloss: This now a daughter of Abraham being, whom bound Satan, look, ten and eight years, not was it necessary to be loosed from the bond this on the day of the Sabbath?

en.L: And this [woman], being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound, look, ten and eight years, was it not necessary that she be loosed from this bond on the day of the Sabbath?"
en.B: And here is a daughter of Abraham whom Satan has kept tied up for eighteen whole years. Should she not be untied from this bond on the Sabbath day?"
en.R: This woman is a daughter of Abraham, one of God's own people. Satan has kept her tied up for eighteen years! Surely it was right to untie her on the Sabbath day!"

es.L: Y esta, siendo hija de Abraham, a quien Satanás ha tenido atada, mira, diez y ocho años, ¿no debía ser desatada de esta atadura el día del sábado?».
es.B: Y aquí está una hija de Abraham a la que Satanás ha tenido atada durante dieciocho largos años. ¿No debía ser desatada de esta atadura en sábado?».
es.R: Esta mujer es hija de Abraham, una del pueblo de Dios. ¡Satanás la ha tenido atada dieciocho años! ¡Claro que era justo desatarla en sábado!».

fr.L: Et celle-ci, qui est une fille d’Abraham, que Satan a liée, voici, dix et huit ans, ne fallait-il pas qu’elle soit détachée de ce lien le jour du sabbat ? »
fr.B: Et voici une fille d’Abraham que Satan tenait attachée depuis dix-huit années entières. Ne fallait-il pas la détacher de ce lien le jour du sabbat ? »
fr.R: Cette femme est une fille d’Abraham : elle fait partie du peuple de Dieu. Satan la tenait attachée depuis dix-huit ans ! Il était sûrement juste de la détacher le jour du sabbat ! »

sw.L: Na huyu, akiwa binti wa Ibrahimu, ambaye Shetani alimfunga, tazama, miaka kumi na minane, je, haikumpasa kufunguliwa kutoka katika kifungo hiki siku ya Sabato?"
sw.B: Na huyu hapa ni binti wa Ibrahimu ambaye Shetani amemfunga kwa miaka kumi na minane mizima. Je, hakupaswa kufunguliwa kifungo hiki siku ya Sabato?"
sw.R: Mwanamke huyu ni binti wa Ibrahimu, mmoja wa watu wa Mungu mwenyewe. Shetani amemfunga kwa miaka kumi na minane! Hakika ilifaa kabisa kumfungua siku ya Sabato!"

ko.L: 그런데 아브라함의 딸인 이 [여자를], 보라, 사탄이 열여덟 해 동안이나 묶어 두었는데, 안식일에 이 매임에서 풀려나야 하지 않았느냐?"
ko.B: 이 여자는 아브라함의 딸이다. 사탄이 이 여자를 열여덟 해 동안이나 묶어 두었다. 그러니 안식일에 이 여자를 그 매임에서 풀어 주어야 하지 않겠느냐?"
ko.R: 이 여자는 아브라함의 딸, 곧 하나님의 백성이다. 사탄이 이 여자를 열여덟 해 동안이나 묶어 두었다! 그러니 안식일에 이 여자를 풀어 주는 것이 마땅하지 않으냐!"

vi.L: Còn người phụ nữ này, là con gái của Áp-ra-ham, mà Sa-tan đã trói buộc, kìa, đã mười tám năm, chẳng phải cần được mở khỏi dây trói này trong ngày Sa-bát sao?"
vi.B: Còn người phụ nữ này là con gái của Áp-ra-ham, đã bị Sa-tan trói buộc suốt mười tám năm trời. Chẳng lẽ bà không được mở khỏi dây trói ấy trong ngày Sa-bát sao?"
vi.R: Người phụ nữ này là con gái của Áp-ra-ham, là người thuộc về dân của Đức Chúa Trời. Sa-tan đã trói buộc bà suốt mười tám năm! Chắc chắn phải mở trói cho bà vào ngày Sa-bát chứ!"

decisions.choice: a daughter of Abraham: a Jewish woman, one of the people of God's promise
alternatives: a descendant of Abraham only by birth
decisions.reason: Abraham's children are the people God made his promises to (1:55, 73). Jesus uses the same kind of name for Zacchaeus (19:9). She belongs to God's people and deserves better than an animal.

decisions.choice: Satan has bound her: her illness is the work of Satan, and healing her frees her from his power
alternatives: a way of saying that she was ill
decisions.reason: Luke speaks of Jesus healing all who were oppressed by the devil (Acts 10:38), and of Jesus overpowering the strong man (11:21-22).

decisions.choice: was it not necessary: the same word the ruler used ("there are six days in which one must work", 13:14)
decisions.reason: Jesus turns the ruler's word around. It was not merely allowed to free her on the Sabbath; it was what had to be done. The day of rest is the right day for release.

decisions.choice: loosed from this bond: the same verb as "untie" the ox in 13:15
decisions.reason: Jesus argues from the smaller to the greater. If an animal is untied on the Sabbath, how much more should this woman be.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: one of God's own people
decisions.reason: Readable explains what being Abraham's daughter means.

decisions.choice: ten and eight years (L); eighteen whole years (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek spells out "ten and eight" for emphasis, and adds "look". Literal keeps the form; Balanced conveys the emphasis with "whole".

decisions.choice: "détacher" for both the animal (13:15) and the woman
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same verb for untying the ox and freeing the woman (m4); French "détacher" works for both, so the comparison stays visible at every level.

decisions.choice: kumi na minane
decisions.reason: The Greek says "ten and eight" here, not the single word of verse 11. The Swahili number is already built that way ("ten and eight"), so Literal needs no different wording.

decisions.choice: "풀다" and "풀려나다" as in 13:15; "-야 하다" (L, B) as the ruler's "일해야 하는" (13:14)
decisions.reason: Jesus answers with the ruler's own word for what is necessary and with the verb he used for untying the ox (meaning decisions), so Korean repeats both.

source.text: καὶ ταῦτα λέγοντος αὐτοῦ κατῃσχύνοντο πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι αὐτῷ, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἔχαιρεν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐνδόξοις τοῖς γινομένοις ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And these things saying of him were put to shame all those opposing him, and all the crowd was rejoicing over all the glorious things being done by him.

en.L: And as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said these things, all those opposing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} were put to shame, and all the crowd was rejoicing over all the glorious things being done by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said this, everyone who had set themselves against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} was put to shame, while the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was doing.
en.R: When Jesus said these things, all the people who were against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} felt ashamed. But the crowd was very happy. They saw all the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was doing.

es.L: Y diciendo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estas cosas, quedaban avergonzados todos los que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} oponían, y toda la multitud se alegraba por todas las cosas gloriosas que eran hechas por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Cuando dijo esto, todos los que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} oponían quedaron avergonzados, mientras que toda la gente se alegraba por todas las cosas gloriosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hacía.
es.R: Cuando Jesús dijo estas cosas, todos los que estaban en contra de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se sintieron avergonzados. Pero la gente estaba muy contenta. Veía todas las cosas maravillosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hacía.

fr.L: Et comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait cela, tous ceux qui s’opposaient à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} étaient couverts de honte, et toute la foule se réjouissait de toutes les choses glorieuses qui se faisaient par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} eut dit cela, tous ceux qui s’étaient dressés contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} furent couverts de honte, tandis que toute la foule se réjouissait de toutes les œuvres glorieuses qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accomplissait.
fr.R: Quand Jésus a dit ces choses, tous ceux qui étaient contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont eu honte. Mais la foule était très heureuse. Les gens voyaient toutes les choses merveilleuses qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} faisait.

sw.L: Na alipokuwa akisema mambo haya, wote waliompinga walitahayarika, na umati wote ulikuwa ukifurahi kwa ajili ya mambo yote matukufu yaliyokuwa yakifanywa na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Aliposema hayo, wote waliokuwa wamejiweka kumpinga waliaibika, nao umati wote ulifurahia mambo yote matukufu aliyokuwa akiyatenda.
sw.R: Yesu aliposema mambo hayo, watu wote waliokuwa wakimpinga waliona aibu. Lakini umati wa watu ulifurahi sana. Waliona mambo yote ya ajabu aliyokuwa akiyafanya.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 이런 말씀을 하시자, 그분을 반대하던 사람들은 모두 부끄러움을 당했다. 그리고 온 무리는 그분이 하시는 모든 영광스러운 일들을 보고 기뻐하고 있었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 이렇게 말씀하시자, 예수를 반대하던 사람들은 모두 부끄러움을 당했다. 그러나 온 무리는 예수께서 하시는 영광스러운 일들을 보고 모두 기뻐하였다.
ko.R: 예수께서 이렇게 말씀하시자, 예수를 반대하던 사람들은 모두 창피를 당했다. 그러나 다른 사람들은 모두 기뻐했다. 예수께서 하시는 놀라운 일들을 보았기 때문이다.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói những điều ấy, tất cả những kẻ chống đối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều bị hổ thẹn, còn cả đám đông thì vui mừng về mọi việc vinh hiển đang được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thực hiện.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói như vậy, tất cả những người chống đối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều bị hổ thẹn, còn cả đám đông thì vui mừng vì mọi việc vinh hiển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang làm.
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu nói những điều ấy, tất cả những người chống đối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều xấu hổ. Còn dân chúng thì rất vui mừng. Họ thấy mọi việc lạ lùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang làm.

decisions.choice: were put to shame: were shown up in public as wrong
decisions.reason: In front of the whole synagogue they had no answer.

decisions.choice: all those opposing him were put to shame: wording found in Isaiah 45:16 in the ancient Greek translation
decisions.reason: Isaiah says that those who oppose God will be put to shame. Luke's words are very close to that passage in Greek.

decisions.choice: the glorious things: wonderful deeds that showed God's power
decisions.reason: The healings were signs of God at work (7:16).

decisions.choice: amazing things
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word. This word is related to glory but is not the key term.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

source.text: Ἔλεγεν οὖν· Τίνι ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τίνι ὁμοιώσω αὐτήν;

records.literal_gloss: He was saying therefore, To what like is the kingdom of God, and to what shall I liken it?

en.L: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying, "What is the kingdom of God like, and to what shall I liken it?
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "What is the kingdom of God like? What picture shall I use for it?
en.R: Then Jesus said, "What is the kingdom of God like? What can I use to show you what it is like?

es.L: Decía, pues: «¿A qué es semejante el reino de Dios, y a qué lo compararé?
es.B: Entonces dijo: «¿A qué se parece el reino de Dios? ¿Con qué imagen lo puedo describir?
es.R: Luego Jesús dijo: «¿Cómo es el reino de Dios? ¿Qué puedo usar para {{plural_you:mostrarles|mostraros}} cómo es?

fr.L: Il disait donc : « À quoi le royaume de Dieu est-il semblable, et à quoi le comparerai-je ?
fr.B: Il dit donc : « À quoi ressemble le royaume de Dieu ? Quelle image vais-je employer pour en parler ?
fr.R: Puis Jésus a dit : « À quoi ressemble le royaume de Dieu ? Qu’est-ce que je peux utiliser pour vous montrer comment il est ?

sw.L: Basi alikuwa akisema, "Ufalme wa Mungu ni kama nini, nami nitaufananisha na nini?
sw.B: Basi alisema, "Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na nini? Niutolee mfano gani?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alisema, "Ufalme wa Mungu ni kama nini? Nitumie nini kuwaonyesha jinsi ulivyo?

ko.L: 그래서 그분이 말씀하고 계셨다. "하나님의 나라는 무엇과 같으며, 내가 그것을 무엇에 견줄까?
ko.B: 그래서 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라는 무엇과 같을까? 내가 그것을 무엇에 견줄까?
ko.R: 그러고 나서 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라는 무엇과 같을까? 무엇으로 그것을 너희에게 보여 줄 수 있을까?

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời giống như gì, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ví vương quốc ấy với gì?
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời giống như điều gì? Ta sẽ dùng hình ảnh nào để nói về vương quốc ấy?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời giống như điều gì? Ta có thể dùng điều gì để cho các người thấy vương quốc ấy như thế nào?

decisions.choice: therefore: the parables follow from what has just happened
alternatives: a new start with no link
decisions.reason: The word ties the sayings to the healing. A woman freed in one synagogue looks small, but the kingdom grows from such beginnings.

decisions.choice: two questions: a teacher's way of introducing a comparison
decisions.reason: Jesus asks the questions in order to answer them himself (Isaiah 40:18).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 13:19
decisions.reason: Luke says "and again he said" at 13:20, so each parable has its own quotation.

decisions.choice: "le royaume de Dieu"
decisions.reason: The New Testament term sheet: "le royaume de Dieu" at every level, as the English keeps "kingdom" at Readable.

source.text: ὁμοία ἐστὶν κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃν λαβὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔβαλεν εἰς κῆπον ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ ηὔξησεν καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς δένδρον, καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Like it is to a grain of mustard, which having taken a man threw into garden of himself, and it grew and became into a tree, and the birds of the sky nested in the branches of it.

en.L: It is like a grain of mustard, which a man took and threw into his own garden; and it grew and became a tree, and the birds of the sky nested in its branches."
en.B: It is like this: a man took a mustard seed and sowed it in his own garden. It kept growing until it was a tree, and birds of the air came and nested among its branches."
en.R: It is like a tiny mustard seed. A man planted it in his garden. It grew and grew until it became a tree. Then birds came and built nests in its branches."

es.L: Es como un grano de mostaza que un hombre tomó y arrojó en su propio huerto; y creció y llegó a ser un árbol, y las aves del cielo fueron a anidar entre sus ramas».
es.B: Es como esto: un hombre tomó una semilla de mostaza y la sembró en su propio huerto. Fue creciendo hasta convertirse en un árbol, y las aves vinieron a hacer sus nidos entre sus ramas».
es.R: Es como una semilla de mostaza muy pequeña. Un hombre la sembró en su huerto. Creció y creció hasta que se hizo un árbol. Entonces vinieron los pájaros e hicieron sus nidos en sus ramas».

fr.L: Il est semblable à un grain de moutarde qu’un homme a pris et jeté dans son jardin ; il a grandi et il est devenu un arbre, et les oiseaux du ciel ont fait leurs nids dans ses branches. »
fr.B: Il en est comme d’une graine de moutarde qu’un homme a prise et semée dans son jardin. Elle a poussé jusqu’à devenir un arbre, et les oiseaux du ciel sont venus nicher dans ses branches. »
fr.R: Il ressemble à une toute petite graine de moutarde. Un homme l’a plantée dans son jardin. Elle a grandi, grandi, et elle est devenue un arbre. Puis des oiseaux sont venus faire leurs nids dans ses branches. »

sw.L: Ni kama chembe ya haradali, ambayo mtu aliichukua akaitupa katika bustani yake mwenyewe; nayo ikakua, ikawa mti, na ndege wa angani wakajenga viota katika matawi yake."
sw.B: Ni kama hivi: mtu mmoja alichukua mbegu ya haradali akaipanda katika bustani yake mwenyewe. Ikaendelea kukua mpaka ikawa mti, na ndege wa angani wakaja kujenga viota katikati ya matawi yake."
sw.R: Ni kama mbegu ndogo sana ya haradali. Mtu mmoja aliipanda katika bustani yake. Ilikua na kukua mpaka ikawa mti. Kisha ndege walikuja na kujenga viota katika matawi yake."

ko.L: 겨자씨 한 알과 같다. 어떤 사람이 그것을 가져다가 자기 정원에 던졌더니, 그것이 자라서 나무가 되었고, 하늘의 새들이 그 가지들에 깃들었다."
ko.B: 그것은 겨자씨와 같다. 어떤 사람이 겨자씨 한 알을 가져다가 자기 밭에 심었다. 그것이 자라서 나무가 되었고, 하늘의 새들이 와서 그 가지에 깃들었다."
ko.R: 하나님의 나라는 아주 작은 겨자씨와 같다. 어떤 사람이 겨자씨를 자기 밭에 심었다. 그 씨가 자라고 자라서 나무가 되었다. 그러자 새들이 와서 그 가지에 둥지를 틀었다."

vi.L: [Vương quốc ấy] giống như một hạt cải mà một người lấy gieo vào vườn của mình; nó mọc lên và trở thành một cây, và chim trời làm tổ trên các cành của nó."
vi.B: Vương quốc ấy giống như thế này: có người lấy một hạt cải gieo trong vườn mình. Hạt ấy cứ lớn lên cho đến khi thành một cây, và chim trời đến làm tổ giữa các cành của nó."
vi.R: Vương quốc ấy giống như một hạt cải rất nhỏ. Có một người gieo hạt ấy trong vườn mình. Nó lớn lên mãi cho đến khi thành một cây. Rồi chim chóc đến làm tổ trên các cành của nó."

decisions.choice: a grain of mustard: a tiny seed that grows into a plant as tall as a person or taller
decisions.reason: The mustard seed was known for being very small (17:6). The plant that grew from it could reach several feet high in a garden.

decisions.choice: the birds nesting in its branches: a picture of a great kingdom sheltering many nations
decisions.reason: The prophets used the picture of a great tree with birds in its branches for a kingdom (Daniel 4; Ezekiel 17:23; 31:6). The kingdom of God begins small and becomes great.

decisions.choice: threw: sowed, planted
decisions.reason: The verb is used for scattering or sowing seed.

decisions.choice: tiny
decisions.reason: Readable says why a mustard seed was chosen: it is very small.

decisions.choice: mustard seed
decisions.reason: "Grain" here means a single seed.

decisions.choice: "정원에 던졌다" (L); "밭에 심었다" (B, R); "깃들다" (L, B), "둥지를 틀다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "threw" and "garden"; the sense is sowing (meaning decision). The birds as in the Korean Mark 4:32 and Matthew 13:32.

decisions.choice: "hạt cải" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:31 and Matthew 13:31.

decisions.choice: "[Vương quốc ấy]" (L)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a subject where the Greek leaves it in the verb, as in Mark 4:31.

source.text: Καὶ πάλιν εἶπεν· Τίνι ὁμοιώσω τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: And again he said, To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?

en.L: And again {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?
en.B: Once more {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "With what shall I compare the kingdom of God?
en.R: Then Jesus said again, "What can I compare the kingdom of God to?

es.L: Y otra vez dijo: «¿A qué compararé el reino de Dios?
es.B: Una vez más dijo: «¿Con qué compararé el reino de Dios?
es.R: Luego Jesús dijo otra vez: «¿Con qué puedo comparar el reino de Dios?

fr.L: Et de nouveau {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « À quoi comparerai-je le royaume de Dieu ?
fr.B: Il dit encore : « À quoi vais-je comparer le royaume de Dieu ?
fr.R: Puis Jésus a dit encore : « À quoi est-ce que je peux comparer le royaume de Dieu ?

sw.L: Na tena akasema, "Nitaufananisha ufalme wa Mungu na nini?
sw.B: Alisema tena, "Ufalme wa Mungu niulinganishe na nini?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alisema tena, "Ufalme wa Mungu naweza kuulinganisha na nini?

ko.L: 그리고 다시 말씀하셨다. "내가 하나님의 나라를 무엇에 견줄까?
ko.B: 예수께서 다시 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라를 무엇에 견줄까?
ko.R: 예수께서 또 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라를 무엇과 비교할 수 있을까?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại nói: "Ta sẽ ví vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời với gì?
vi.B: Ngài lại nói tiếp: "Ta sẽ so sánh vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời với điều gì?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu lại nói: "Ta có thể so sánh vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời với điều gì?

decisions.choice: again: a second picture with the same point, as Jesus often pairs a man and a woman
decisions.reason: The mustard seed and the yeast belong together, like the shepherd and the woman in 15:3-10.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

source.text: ὁμοία ἐστὶν ζύμῃ, ἣν λαβοῦσα γυνὴ ἔκρυψεν εἰς ἀλεύρου σάτα τρία ἕως οὗ ἐζυμώθη ὅλον.

records.literal_gloss: Like it is to leaven, which having taken a woman hid into of flour measures three, until was leavened all.

en.L: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour until all [of it] was leavened."
en.B: It is like yeast. A woman took some and hid it in {{units:about 40 pounds|three measures}} of flour, and in time the whole batch rose."
en.R: It is like yeast. A woman mixed a little yeast into a big batch of flour, {{units:about 40 pounds|three measures}}. The yeast worked its way through until all the dough had risen."

es.L: Es como levadura que una mujer tomó y ocultó en tres medidas de harina, hasta que todo quedó leudado».
es.B: Es como la levadura. Una mujer tomó un poco y la escondió en {{units:unos 18 kilos|tres medidas}} de harina, y con el tiempo toda la masa subió».
es.R: Es como la levadura. Una mujer mezcló un poco de levadura con mucha harina, {{units:unos 18 kilos|tres medidas}}. La levadura fue avanzando hasta que toda la masa subió».

fr.L: Il est semblable à du levain qu’une femme a pris et caché dans trois mesures de farine, jusqu’à ce que le tout ait levé. »
fr.B: Il est semblable au levain qu’une femme a pris pour l’enfouir dans {{units:une vingtaine de kilos|trois mesures}} de farine ; et peu à peu, toute la pâte a levé. »
fr.R: Il ressemble au levain. Une femme a mélangé un peu de levain dans une grande quantité de farine, {{units:une vingtaine de kilos|trois mesures}}. Le levain a agi peu à peu, jusqu’à ce que toute la pâte ait levé. »

sw.L: Ni kama chachu, ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaificha katika vipimo vitatu vya unga mpaka unga wote ukachachuka."
sw.B: Ni kama chachu. Mwanamke mmoja alichukua kidogo akaificha katika {{units:karibu kilo 18 za|vipimo vitatu vya}} unga, na baada ya muda unga wote ukaumka."
sw.R: Ni kama chachu. Mwanamke mmoja alichanganya chachu kidogo na unga mwingi, {{units:karibu kilo 18|vipimo vitatu}}. Chachu ikaenea mpaka unga wote ukaumka."

ko.L: 누룩과 같다. 한 여자가 그것을 가져다가 밀가루 세 사톤 속에 숨겨 넣었더니, 마침내 전부가 부풀어 올랐다."
ko.B: 그것은 누룩과 같다. 한 여자가 누룩을 가져다가 {{units:약 18킬로그램|세 사톤}}의 밀가루에 섞어 넣었더니, 마침내 반죽 전체가 부풀어 올랐다."
ko.R: 그것은 누룩과 같다. 한 여자가 누룩을 조금 가져다가 아주 많은 밀가루, {{units:약 18킬로그램|세 사톤}}에 섞었다. 그러자 누룩이 퍼져서 마침내 반죽 전체가 부풀어 올랐다."

vi.L: Vương quốc ấy giống như men mà một người phụ nữ lấy giấu vào trong ba đấu bột, cho đến khi tất cả [bột] đều dậy men."
vi.B: Vương quốc ấy giống như men. Một người phụ nữ lấy men trộn kín vào trong {{units:khoảng 18 kg|ba đấu}} bột, rồi dần dần cả khối bột đều dậy men."
vi.R: Vương quốc ấy giống như men. Một người phụ nữ lấy một chút men trộn vào một khối bột lớn, {{units:khoảng 18 kg|ba đấu}}. Men thấm dần khắp nơi cho đến khi cả khối bột đều dậy lên."

decisions.choice: leaven: a lump of old, fermented dough kept back to make the next batch rise
decisions.reason: A little leaven works through a whole batch of dough (12:1). Here the picture is of something small and hidden that spreads through everything, for good.

decisions.choice: hid: mixed in, so that it could not be seen
alternatives: put away to keep it safe
decisions.reason: The word is unusual for mixing dough, and it fits the point: the kingdom is at work even when it is hidden.

decisions.choice: three measures of flour: a very large amount, enough bread for a great many people
decisions.reason: A measure (saton) was a dry measure of perhaps 7 to 13 liters; the estimates vary. Sarah baked from three measures of flour for her three visitors (Genesis 18:6).

decisions.choice: yeast (B, R); leaven (L)
decisions.reason: "Leaven" is no longer an everyday word, as at 12:1.

decisions.choice: about 40 pounds by default; "three measures" as the Measures alternative
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the unit, called a measure as at John 2:6. The size of a saton is uncertain, so the figure is approximate.

decisions.choice: a little yeast
decisions.reason: Readable says what the parable assumes: a little yeast affects a lot of dough.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 18 kilos|tres medidas}}
decisions.reason: Three measures were a very large amount of flour (meaning decision m3). As in Matthew 13:33, Spanish gives a metric weight by default, where the English gives pounds, with the original measure as the alternative; Literal keeps "tres medidas".

decisions.choice: "le levain" at every level
decisions.reason: English moves to "yeast" because "leaven" is no longer an everyday word; French "levain" still is ("pain au levain"), and it is exactly what m1 describes, old fermented dough kept back. "Levure" names a different product.

decisions.choice: "une vingtaine de kilos" by default; "trois mesures" as the Measures alternative
decisions.reason: French defaults to metric where English uses US units. Three seahs held roughly 36 to 40 litres, about twenty kilos of flour; the size of the measure is uncertain, so the figure stays round. Literal keeps the unit.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu kilo 18 za|vipimo vitatu vya}} (B); {{units:karibu kilo 18|vipimo vitatu}} (R)
decisions.reason: Three measures were a very large amount of flour (meaning decision m3). As in Matthew 13:33, Swahili gives a metric weight by default, where the English gives pounds, with the original measure as the alternative; Literal keeps "vipimo vitatu". At Balanced the span takes in the linking word, which agrees with its noun.

decisions.choice: Metric "약 18킬로그램" by default, "세 사톤" as the Measures alternative (B, R); "세 사톤" (L)
decisions.reason: The Korean style guide uses metric by default, unlike the English; the wording of the Korean Matthew 13:33.

decisions.choice: "누룩" at every level; "숨겨 넣다" (L), "섞어 넣다" (B), "섞다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Matthew 13:33; the hiding means mixing in (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "giấu vào" (L); "trộn kín vào" (B); "trộn vào" (R)
