decisions.reason: Literal keeps Luke's verb "hid"; Balanced keeps the sense of hidden in "kín" while saying what the woman did (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 18 kg|ba đấu}}: metric by default, the original measure as the alternative
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese guide gives metric as the modern default, unlike the English (US pounds); the amount is the same as in Matthew 13:33. Literal keeps "ba đấu".

source.text: Καὶ διεπορεύετο κατὰ πόλεις καὶ κώμας διδάσκων καὶ πορείαν ποιούμενος εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

records.literal_gloss: And he was going through by towns and villages, teaching and journey making toward Jerusalem.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was going through towns and villages one after another, teaching and making a journey toward Jerusalem.
en.B: Jesus traveled on from town to town and village to village, teaching, and pressing on toward Jerusalem.
en.R: Jesus kept going through the towns and villages. He taught the people there as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} traveled on toward Jerusalem.

es.L: Y recorría ciudades y aldeas, una tras otra, enseñando y haciendo camino hacia Jerusalén.
es.B: Jesús siguió adelante de ciudad en ciudad y de aldea en aldea, enseñando y avanzando hacia Jerusalén.
es.R: Jesús seguía pasando por las ciudades y las aldeas. Enseñaba a la gente de esos lugares mientras seguía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} camino hacia Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} traversait villes et villages l’un après l’autre, enseignant et faisant route vers Jérusalem.
fr.B: Jésus passait de ville en ville et de village en village ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait et poursuivait {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} route vers Jérusalem.
fr.R: Jésus continuait à traverser les villes et les villages. Il enseignait les gens de ces endroits pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} continuait {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} voyage vers Jérusalem.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akipita katika miji na vijiji, akifundisha na kufanya safari kuelekea Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Yesu aliendelea na safari kutoka mji hadi mji na kijiji hadi kijiji, akifundisha na kusonga mbele kuelekea Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yesu aliendelea kupita katika miji na vijiji. Aliwafundisha watu huko alipokuwa akisafiri kuelekea Yerusalemu.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 고을과 마을을 두루 다니시며 가르치시고, 예루살렘을 향하여 길을 가고 계셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 여러 고을과 마을을 거쳐 가시면서 가르치셨고, 예루살렘을 향해 계속 길을 가셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 이 마을 저 마을을 거쳐 가시면서 사람들을 가르치셨다. 그리고 예루살렘을 향해 계속 가셨다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi qua hết thành này đến thành khác, làng này đến làng khác, vừa giảng dạy vừa lên đường đi về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu tiếp tục đi qua các thành và các làng, vừa đi vừa giảng dạy, trên đường tiến về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu tiếp tục đi qua các thị trấn và các làng. Ngài dạy dỗ dân chúng ở đó trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi về phía Giê-ru-sa-lem.

decisions.choice: toward Jerusalem: Luke reminds his readers of the journey Jesus set out on in 9:51
alternatives: a short trip to the city
decisions.reason: Jesus is going to Jerusalem to die and rise (9:22, 51; 13:33).

decisions.choice: through towns and villages: from one place to the next
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures him moving from place to place.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

source.text: εἶπεν δέ τις αὐτῷ· Κύριε, εἰ ὀλίγοι οἱ σῳζόμενοι;

records.literal_gloss: Said then someone to him, Lord, [are] few those being saved?

en.L: And someone said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, are those being saved few?"
en.B: Someone asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, is it only a few who are being saved?"
en.R: Someone said to Jesus, "Lord, will God save only a small number of people?"

es.L: Y uno {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Señor, ¿son pocos los que se salvan?».
es.B: Alguien {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntó: «Señor, ¿son solo unos pocos los que se están salvando?».
es.R: Alguien le preguntó a Jesús: «Señor, ¿va a salvar Dios solo a unas pocas personas?».

fr.L: Et quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Seigneur, ceux qui sont sauvés sont-ils peu nombreux ? »
fr.B: Quelqu’un {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanda : « Seigneur, n’y a-t-il qu’un petit nombre de gens qui soient sauvés ? »
fr.R: Quelqu’un a dit à Jésus : « Seigneur, est-ce que Dieu va sauver seulement un petit nombre de gens ? »

sw.L: Na mtu mmoja akamwambia, "Bwana, je, ni wachache wanaookolewa?"
sw.B: Mtu mmoja alimwuliza, "Bwana, je, ni wachache tu wanaookolewa?"
sw.R: Mtu mmoja alimwambia Yesu, "Bwana, je, Mungu ataokoa watu wachache tu?"

ko.L: 그런데 어떤 사람이 그분께 말했다. "주님, 구원받는 사람들이 적습니까?"
ko.B: 어떤 사람이 예수께 물었다. "주님, 구원받는 사람은 몇 안 됩니까?"
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 예수께 물었다. "주님, 하나님께서 적은 수의 사람만 구원하십니까?"

vi.L: Và có người nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Chúa, những người được cứu thì ít sao?"
vi.B: Có người hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Chúa, có phải chỉ ít người được cứu thôi không?"
vi.R: Có người hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Chúa, có phải Đức Chúa Trời chỉ cứu một số ít người thôi không?"

decisions.choice: if: here it introduces a direct question
decisions.reason: Luke sometimes uses this word to open a direct question (22:49).

decisions.choice: those being saved: those whom God is rescuing from judgment and bringing into his kingdom
decisions.reason: The present tense speaks of people on the way to that rescue (Acts 2:47). Jesus' answer is about entering the kingdom (13:24-29).

decisions.choice: will God save
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who saves, which the passive implies.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Chúa" with no setting span
decisions.reason: As for the men who speak to Jesus on the road in 9:59 and 9:61: the English keeps "Lord", and "Thưa" is the respectful word of someone in the crowd.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς·

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them,

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them,
en.B: He said to them,
en.R: Jesus said to all of them,

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo:
es.B: Él les dijo:
es.R: Jesús les dijo a todos:

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit :
fr.B: Il leur dit :
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit à tous :

sw.L: Naye akawaambia,
sw.B: Aliwaambia,
sw.R: Yesu aliwaambia wote,

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 거기 있는 모든 사람에게 말씀하셨다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ:
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ:
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với mọi người ở đó:

decisions.choice: to them: Jesus answers everyone present, not just the one who asked
decisions.reason: The question was about others; Jesus turns it into a call to his hearers themselves.

decisions.choice: all of them
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the answer goes to everyone.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

source.text: Ἀγωνίζεσθε εἰσελθεῖν διὰ τῆς στενῆς θύρας, ὅτι πολλοί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητήσουσιν εἰσελθεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύσουσιν, ἀφ’ οὗ ἂν ἐγερθῇ ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης καὶ ἀποκλείσῃ τὴν θύραν, καὶ ἄρξησθε ἔξω ἑστάναι καὶ κρούειν τὴν θύραν λέγοντες· Κύριε, ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν· καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ἐρεῖ ὑμῖν· Οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς πόθεν ἐστέ.

records.literal_gloss: Strive to enter through the narrow door, because many, I say to you, will seek to enter and not will be able, \v 25 from when has risen the master of the house and has shut the door, and you begin outside to stand and to knock the door saying, Lord, open to us, and answering he will say to you, Not I know you from where you are.

en.L: "Strive to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will seek to enter and will not be able, \v 25 once the master of the house has risen and shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock on the door, saying, 'Lord, open to us,' and he will answer and say to you, 'I do not know you, where you are from.'
en.B: "Struggle hard to get in through the narrow door. Many people, I tell you, will look for a way in and will fail. \v 25 When the master of the house has risen and locked the door, you will find yourselves outside. You will knock and call out, 'Lord, open up for us!' And his answer to you will be, 'I do not know you; I do not know where you are from.'
en.R: "Work hard to go in through the narrow door. I tell you, many people will try to go in, but they will not be able to. \v 25 The master of the house will get up and shut the door. Then you will stand outside and knock on the door. You will say, 'Lord, open the door for us!' But he will say, 'I do not know you. I do not know where you come from.'

es.L: «{{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}} por entrar por la puerta estrecha, porque muchos, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, procurarán entrar y no podrán, \v 25 una vez que el dueño de la casa se haya levantado y haya cerrado la puerta, y {{plural_you:comiencen|comencéis}} a estar afuera y a llamar a la puerta, diciendo: “Señor, ábrenos”, y él, respondiendo, {{plural_you:les|os}} dirá: “No {{plural_you:los|os}} conozco; [no sé] de dónde {{plural_you:son|sois}}”.
es.B: «{{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}} de veras por entrar por la puerta estrecha. Porque muchos, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, buscarán cómo entrar y no lo lograrán. \v 25 Cuando el dueño de la casa se haya levantado y haya cerrado la puerta con llave, {{plural_you:ustedes se quedarán|vosotros os quedaréis}} afuera. {{plural_you:Llamarán|Llamaréis}} a la puerta y {{plural_you:gritarán|gritaréis}}: “¡Señor, ábrenos!”. Y él {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá: “No {{plural_you:los|os}} conozco; no sé de dónde {{plural_you:son|sois}}”.
es.R: «{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} todo lo posible por entrar por la puerta estrecha. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que mucha gente tratará de entrar, pero no podrá. \v 25 El dueño de la casa se levantará y cerrará la puerta. Entonces {{plural_you:ustedes estarán|vosotros estaréis}} afuera y {{plural_you:llamarán|llamaréis}} a la puerta. {{plural_you:Dirán|Diréis}}: “¡Señor, ábrenos la puerta!”. Pero él {{plural_you:les|os}} dirá: “No {{plural_you:los|os}} conozco. No sé de dónde {{plural_you:vienen|venís}}”.

fr.L: « Luttez pour entrer par la porte étroite, car beaucoup, je vous le dis, chercheront à entrer et ne le pourront pas, \v 25 une fois que le maître de maison se sera levé et aura fermé la porte, et que vous commencerez à vous tenir dehors et à frapper à la porte en disant : “Seigneur, ouvre-nous”, et il vous répondra : “Je ne vous connais pas, [je ne sais] d’où vous êtes.”
fr.B: « Luttez de toutes vos forces pour entrer par la porte étroite. Beaucoup, je vous le dis, chercheront à entrer et n’y parviendront pas. \v 25 Quand le maître de maison se sera levé et aura verrouillé la porte, vous vous retrouverez dehors. Vous frapperez à la porte et vous crierez : “Seigneur, ouvre-nous !” Et il vous répondra : “Je ne vous connais pas ; je ne sais pas d’où vous êtes.”
fr.R: « Faites tous vos efforts pour entrer par la porte étroite. Je vous le dis, beaucoup de gens essaieront d’entrer, mais ils ne pourront pas. \v 25 Le maître de la maison va se lever et fermer la porte. Alors vous resterez dehors et vous frapperez à la porte. Vous direz : “Seigneur, ouvre-nous la porte !” Mais il vous répondra : “Je ne vous connais pas. Je ne sais pas d’où vous venez.”

sw.L: "Jitahidini kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba, kwa sababu wengi, nawaambia, watatafuta kuingia nao hawataweza, \v 25 mara mwenye nyumba atakapokuwa ameinuka na kuufunga mlango, nanyi mkaanza kusimama nje na kuubisha mlango, mkisema, 'Bwana, tufungulie,' naye atajibu na kuwaambia, 'Siwajui ninyi, [wala] mtokako.'
sw.B: "Jitahidini sana kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba. Nawaambia, wengi watatafuta njia ya kuingia lakini hawataweza. \v 25 Mwenye nyumba akishainuka na kuufunga mlango, mtajikuta mko nje. Mtabisha mlango na kuita, 'Bwana, tufungulie!' Naye atawajibu, 'Siwajui; sijui mtokako.'
sw.R: "Fanyeni bidii kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba. Nawaambia, watu wengi watajaribu kuingia, lakini hawataweza. \v 25 Mwenye nyumba ataamka na kuufunga mlango. Ndipo mtasimama nje na kubisha mlango. Mtasema, 'Bwana, tufungulie mlango!' Lakini yeye atasema, 'Siwajui. Sijui mnakotoka.'

ko.L: "좁은 문으로 들어가기를 힘써라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 많은 사람이 들어가려고 하겠지만 들어갈 수 없을 것이기 때문이다. \v 25 집주인이 일어나 문을 닫아 버린 뒤에, 너희가 밖에 서서 문을 두드리며 '주님, 우리에게 열어 주십시오' 하고 말하기 시작하면, 그가 너희에게 대답하여 '나는 너희를, 너희가 어디에서 왔는지 알지 못한다' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: "좁은 문으로 들어가려고 힘써라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 많은 사람이 들어가려고 애쓰겠지만 들어가지 못할 것이다. \v 25 집주인이 일어나서 문을 잠가 버리면, 너희는 밖에 서서 문을 두드리며 '주님, 문을 열어 주십시오!' 하고 외칠 것이다. 그러나 주인은 너희에게 '나는 너희를 모른다. 너희가 어디에서 왔는지 모른다' 하고 대답할 것이다.
ko.R: "좁은 문으로 들어가도록 온 힘을 다하여라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 많은 사람이 들어가려고 하겠지만 들어가지 못할 것이다. \v 25 집주인이 일어나서 문을 닫을 것이다. 그러면 너희는 밖에 서서 문을 두드리며 '주님, 문을 열어 주십시오!' 하고 말할 것이다. 그러나 주인은 '나는 너희를 모른다. 너희가 어디에서 왔는지 모른다' 하고 대답할 것이다.

vi.L: "Hãy gắng sức để vào qua cửa hẹp, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, nhiều người sẽ tìm cách vào mà không thể được, \v 25 một khi chủ nhà đã đứng dậy và đóng cửa lại, và các người bắt đầu đứng bên ngoài và gõ cửa, nói: 'Thưa Chúa, xin mở cho chúng tôi,' thì chủ nhà sẽ đáp lời và nói với các người: 'Ta không biết các người, các người từ đâu đến.'
vi.B: "Hãy hết sức cố gắng để vào qua cửa hẹp. Ta nói với các người, nhiều người sẽ tìm cách vào mà không vào được. \v 25 Khi chủ nhà đã đứng dậy và khóa cửa lại, các người sẽ thấy mình đứng ở bên ngoài. Các người sẽ gõ cửa và kêu lên: 'Thưa Chúa, xin mở cửa cho chúng tôi!' Nhưng chủ nhà sẽ trả lời các người: 'Ta không biết các người. Ta không biết các người từ đâu đến.'
vi.R: "Hãy cố gắng hết sức để đi vào qua cửa hẹp. Ta nói cho các người biết, nhiều người sẽ tìm cách vào nhưng không vào được. \v 25 Chủ nhà sẽ đứng dậy và đóng cửa lại. Khi ấy các người sẽ đứng bên ngoài và gõ cửa. Các người sẽ nói: 'Thưa Chúa, xin mở cửa cho chúng tôi!' Nhưng chủ nhà sẽ nói: 'Ta không biết các người. Ta không biết các người từ đâu đến.'

decisions.choice: strive: struggle with all one's strength, as in a contest
decisions.reason: The word was used for athletes competing for a prize. Jesus does not answer how many will be saved; he tells his hearers to make sure they enter.

decisions.choice: the narrow door: the way into the kingdom, open now but not for ever
decisions.reason: The door is narrow and will be shut. The time to enter is now, by turning to God while Jesus calls (13:3, 5).

decisions.choice: 13:25 continues the sentence of 13:24: many will not be able to enter once the door is shut
alternatives: 13:25 begins a new sentence, completed in 13:26: "when the master has shut the door ... then you will begin to say"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT joins the verses with a comma. Some editions start a new sentence at 13:25. The meaning is much the same: the door closes and latecomers are kept out.

decisions.choice: I do not know where you are from: you are strangers to me, not part of my household
alternatives: I do not know your hometown
decisions.reason: The master disowns them. He does not recognize them as his own (Matthew 25:12).

decisions.choice: the master of the house: a figure in the picture who stands for Jesus
decisions.reason: Those outside say that they ate with him and that he taught in their streets (13:26), which describes Jesus' own ministry.

decisions.choice: Lord
decisions.reason: The people at the door address the master of the house with the title that also means the Lord, as people call Jesus "Lord" in 6:46.

decisions.choice: several short sentences
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the long sentence so it can be followed aloud.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 13:30; the words of the people and the master are in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer in 13:24-30 is one speech.

decisions.choice: "Luttez" (L, B); "Faites tous vos efforts" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is the word for a contest (m1); "luttez" keeps that picture, where "efforcez-vous" says only "try hard". Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: the words of the people and of the master in “ ” inside the speech
alternatives: single quotation marks, as in English
decisions.reason: French typography marks a quotation inside a quotation with “ ” within « »; the same throughout 13:6-9 and 13:24-35.

decisions.choice: mlango
decisions.reason: Luke's word here is the door of a house, which the master shuts (verse 25), not the city gate of Matthew 7:13, where Swahili has "lango".

decisions.choice: The people outside call the master "주님" and plead in 합쇼체; he answers in 해라체
decisions.reason: The master of the house stands for Jesus (meaning decision), and the knocking people use the address disciples use for him; his reply is the plain style Jesus uses.

decisions.choice: the people at the door say "Thưa Chúa" and "chúng tôi"; the master answers "Ta ... các người", with no setting span; "chủ nhà" is repeated instead of a pronoun
decisions.reason: The master of the house is a figure in the picture who stands for Jesus (meaning decision): the English keeps "Lord" and writes his "me" with no capital option, so no deity_pronoun span is used, as for the figures in Jesus' parables. The people knock as outsiders, so they say "chúng tôi", not the disciples' "chúng con". Repeating "chủ nhà" avoids calling this figure "ông". Kept through 13:27.

source.text: τότε ἄρξεσθε λέγειν· Ἐφάγομεν ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ ἐπίομεν, καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡμῶν ἐδίδαξας·

records.literal_gloss: Then you will begin to say, We ate in presence of you and drank, and in the streets of us you taught;

en.L: Then you will begin to say, 'We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.'
en.B: Then you will begin to protest, 'We ate and drank in your company, and it was in our streets that you taught!'
en.R: Then you will say, 'We ate and drank with you! You taught in the streets of our town!'

es.L: Entonces {{plural_you:comenzarán|comenzaréis}} a decir: “Comimos y bebimos delante de ti, y en nuestras calles enseñaste”.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:empezarán|empezaréis}} a protestar: “¡Comimos y bebimos contigo, y fue en nuestras calles donde enseñaste!”.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}}: “¡Comimos y bebimos contigo! ¡Tú enseñaste en las calles de nuestro pueblo!”.

fr.L: Alors vous commencerez à dire : “Nous avons mangé et bu devant toi, et tu as enseigné dans nos rues.”
fr.B: Alors vous vous mettrez à protester : “Nous avons mangé et bu en ta compagnie, et c’est dans nos rues que tu as enseigné !”
fr.R: Alors vous direz : “Nous avons mangé et bu avec toi ! Tu as enseigné dans les rues de notre ville !”

sw.L: Ndipo mtaanza kusema, 'Tulikula na kunywa mbele yako, nawe ulifundisha katika mitaa yetu.'
sw.B: Ndipo mtaanza kudai, 'Tulikula na kunywa pamoja nawe, na ni katika mitaa yetu ulipofundisha!'
sw.R: Ndipo mtasema, 'Tulikula na kunywa pamoja nawe! Ulifundisha katika mitaa ya mji wetu!'

ko.L: 그때에 너희는 '우리는 주님 앞에서 먹고 마셨고, 주님께서는 우리 거리에서 가르치셨습니다' 하고 말하기 시작할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러면 너희는 '우리는 주님과 함께 먹고 마셨습니다. 주님께서 우리 동네 거리에서 가르치시지 않았습니까?' 하고 따질 것이다.
ko.R: 그러면 너희는 '우리는 주님과 함께 먹고 마셨습니다! 주님께서 우리 마을 거리에서 가르치셨습니다!' 하고 말할 것이다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ các người sẽ bắt đầu nói: 'Chúng tôi đã ăn và uống trước mặt Chúa, và Chúa đã giảng dạy trên các đường phố của chúng tôi.'
vi.B: Bấy giờ các người sẽ bắt đầu phân trần: 'Chúng tôi đã từng ăn uống với Chúa, và Chúa đã dạy dỗ trên các đường phố của chúng tôi!'
vi.R: Lúc ấy các người sẽ nói: 'Chúng tôi đã ăn uống với Chúa! Chúa đã dạy dỗ trên các đường phố trong thị trấn chúng tôi!'

decisions.choice: we ate and drank in your presence: we shared meals with you
alternatives: we ate at a feast you gave
decisions.reason: Eating together was a sign of friendship. They claim to know him because they were near him.

decisions.choice: you taught in our streets: they heard Jesus but did not respond
decisions.reason: Being near Jesus and hearing him is not the same as entering through the door. The picture of the master of the house here shows Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: you, with no capital option
decisions.reason: The people are speaking to the master of the house in the picture. Although he stands for Jesus, pronouns for a figure in a parable are not treated as pronouns for God or Christ.

decisions.choice: "you" rendered by the title "주님" with the honorific, not by a pronoun
decisions.reason: Korean avoids a second-person pronoun for someone addressed with respect; the speakers keep calling him what they called him in 13:25.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for "you", with no setting span
decisions.reason: As the style guide says for those who call him Lord: "Chúa" stands for "you" and takes no deity_pronoun span, as the English "you" here has none.

source.text: καὶ ἐρεῖ λέγων ὑμῖν· Οὐκ οἶδα πόθεν ἐστέ· ἀπόστητε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ, πάντες ἐργάται ἀδικίας.

records.literal_gloss: And he will say, telling you, Not I know from where you are; depart from me, all workers of unrighteousness.

en.L: And he will say, telling you, 'I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all [you] workers of unrighteousness.'
en.B: But he will tell you, 'I do not know where you come from. Go away from me, all of you whose work is wrongdoing!'
en.R: But he will say to you again, 'I do not know where you come from. Go away from me, all of you who do evil things!'

es.L: Y dirá, {{plural_you:diciéndoles|diciéndoos}}: “No sé de dónde {{plural_you:son|sois}}; {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de mí, todos [{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}] obreros de injusticia”.
es.B: Pero él {{plural_you:les|os}} dirá: “No sé de dónde {{plural_you:vienen|venís}}. ¡{{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} de mí, todos {{plural_you:ustedes, que se dedican|vosotros, que os dedicáis}} a hacer el mal!”.
es.R: Pero él {{plural_you:les|os}} volverá a decir: “No sé de dónde {{plural_you:vienen|venís}}. ¡{{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de mí, todos {{plural_you:ustedes que hacen|vosotros que hacéis}} cosas malas!”.

fr.L: Et il dira, s’adressant à vous : “Je ne sais pas d’où vous êtes. Éloignez-vous de moi, vous tous, ouvriers d’injustice.”
fr.B: Mais il vous dira : “Je ne sais pas d’où vous venez. Éloignez-vous de moi, vous tous, artisans du mal !”
fr.R: Mais il vous redira : “Je ne sais pas d’où vous venez. Allez-vous-en loin de moi, vous tous qui faites le mal !”

sw.L: Naye atasema, akiwaambia, 'Sijui mtokako; ondokeni kwangu, ninyi nyote watenda udhalimu.'
sw.B: Lakini atawaambia, 'Sijui mtokako. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi nyote ambao kazi yenu ni kutenda maovu!'
sw.R: Lakini atawaambia tena, 'Sijui mnakotoka. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi nyote mnaotenda mambo mabaya!'

ko.L: 그러나 그는 너희에게 이렇게 말할 것이다. '나는 너희가 어디에서 왔는지 알지 못한다. 불의를 행하는 모든 자들아, 나에게서 물러가라.'
ko.B: 그러나 주인은 너희에게 말할 것이다. '나는 너희가 어디에서 왔는지 모른다. 불의를 일삼는 자들아, 모두 나에게서 물러가라!'
ko.R: 그러나 주인은 너희에게 다시 말할 것이다. '나는 너희가 어디에서 왔는지 모른다. 나쁜 일을 하는 사람들아, 모두 나에게서 떠나가라!'

vi.L: Và [chủ nhà] sẽ nói, bảo các người: 'Ta không biết các người từ đâu đến; hãy lui ra khỏi ta, hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều bất chính.'
vi.B: Nhưng chủ nhà sẽ bảo các người: 'Ta không biết các người từ đâu đến. Hãy lui ra khỏi ta, hết thảy những kẻ làm điều gian ác!'
vi.R: Nhưng chủ nhà sẽ nói lại với các người: 'Ta không biết các người từ đâu đến. Hãy đi khỏi ta, tất cả những kẻ làm điều ác!'

decisions.choice: and he will say, telling you: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: and he will say, "I tell you, I do not know ...", the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have "I tell you" as part of the master's words, and some leave out the words "I tell you" or "telling you" altogether. The sense is the same: the master repeats his answer. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: depart from me, all workers of unrighteousness: words from Psalm 6:9
alternatives: Jesus' own words with no source
decisions.reason: In the psalm the one praying tells all evildoers to leave him, because the Lord has heard him. Here the master says them to those he sends away.

decisions.choice: unrighteousness: wrongdoing, injustice
decisions.reason: The word is the opposite of what is right and just.

decisions.choice: again
decisions.reason: The master repeats what he said in 13:25. Readable makes the repeat clear.

decisions.choice: all of you whose work is wrongdoing (B); all of you who do evil things (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of work in plain words; Readable says it simply.

decisions.choice: "artisans du mal"
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of work, as the English does, in a short French phrase that can be read aloud.

decisions.choice: "불의를 행하는 모든 자들" (L); "불의를 일삼는 자들" (B); "나쁜 일을 하는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: "불의" keeps the word for unrighteousness at Literal and Balanced; Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "điều bất chính" (L); "điều gian ác" (B); "điều ác" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision gives wrongdoing and injustice; "bất chính" keeps the link with righteousness at Literal, and the other levels use the common words for evildoing.

source.text: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων, ὅταν ὄψησθε Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ καὶ πάντας τοὺς προφήτας ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὑμᾶς δὲ ἐκβαλλομένους ἔξω.

records.literal_gloss: There will be the weeping and the grinding of the teeth, when you see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you being thrown out outside.

en.L: There will be weeping and grinding of teeth there, when you see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but yourselves being thrown outside.
en.B: You will weep there and grind your teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob and every one of the prophets inside the kingdom of God, and yourselves driven out.
en.R: You will cry and grind your teeth in anger and pain. You will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God. But you will be thrown outside.

es.L: Allí habrá el llanto y el rechinar de los dientes, cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} a Abraham, a Isaac, a Jacob y a todos los profetas en el reino de Dios, y a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos echados fuera.
es.B: Allí {{plural_you:llorarán|lloraréis}} y {{plural_you:rechinarán|rechinaréis}} los dientes cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} a Abraham, Isaac y Jacob y a todos los profetas dentro del reino de Dios, y a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos expulsados.
es.R: {{plural_you:Llorarán|Lloraréis}} y {{plural_you:rechinarán|rechinaréis}} los dientes de rabia y de dolor. {{plural_you:Verán|Veréis}} a Abraham, a Isaac, a Jacob y a todos los profetas en el reino de Dios. Pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:los|os}} echarán fuera.

fr.L: Là, il y aura les pleurs et le grincement des dents, quand vous verrez Abraham et Isaac et Jacob et tous les prophètes dans le royaume de Dieu, et vous-mêmes jetés dehors.
fr.B: Vous pleurerez là et vous grincerez des dents, quand vous verrez Abraham, Isaac, Jacob et tous les prophètes dans le royaume de Dieu, et que vous serez, vous, chassés dehors.
fr.R: Vous pleurerez et vous grincerez des dents, de colère et de douleur. Vous verrez Abraham, Isaac, Jacob et tous les prophètes dans le royaume de Dieu. Mais vous, vous serez jetés dehors.

sw.L: Huko kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno, mtakapowaona Ibrahimu na Isaka na Yakobo na manabii wote katika ufalme wa Mungu, lakini ninyi wenyewe mkitupwa nje.
sw.B: Huko mtalia na kusaga meno mtakapowaona Ibrahimu, Isaka na Yakobo, na manabii wote ndani ya ufalme wa Mungu, nanyi wenyewe mmefukuzwa nje.
sw.R: Mtalia na kusaga meno kwa hasira na uchungu. Mtawaona Ibrahimu, Isaka, Yakobo na manabii wote katika ufalme wa Mungu. Lakini ninyi mtatupwa nje.

ko.L: 거기에서 울음과 이를 가는 일이 있을 것이다. 너희가 아브라함과 이삭과 야곱과 모든 예언자들은 하나님의 나라 안에 있고, 너희 자신은 밖으로 쫓겨나는 것을 볼 때에 [그러할 것이다].
ko.B: 너희는 아브라함과 이삭과 야곱과 모든 예언자가 하나님의 나라 안에 있고, 너희 자신은 밖으로 쫓겨난 것을 보게 될 것이다. 그때 너희는 거기서 울며 이를 갈 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 아브라함과 이삭과 야곱과 모든 예언자가 하나님의 나라에 있는 것을 볼 것이다. 그러나 너희는 밖으로 쫓겨날 것이다. 그래서 너희는 거기서 슬피 울며, 괴로워서 이를 갈 것이다.

vi.L: Ở đó sẽ có khóc lóc và nghiến răng, khi các người thấy Áp-ra-ham và Y-sác và Gia-cốp và tất cả các nhà tiên tri ở trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời, còn chính các người thì bị ném ra ngoài.
vi.B: Các người sẽ khóc lóc và nghiến răng ở đó khi thấy Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác, Gia-cốp và tất cả các nhà tiên tri ở trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời, còn chính các người thì bị đuổi ra ngoài.
vi.R: Các người sẽ khóc lóc và nghiến răng vì đau đớn và tức giận. Các người sẽ thấy Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác, Gia-cốp và tất cả các nhà tiên tri ở trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời. Nhưng các người thì bị ném ra ngoài.

decisions.choice: weeping and grinding of teeth: bitter grief and anguish
decisions.reason: Weeping shows grief; grinding the teeth shows anguish and anger (Psalm 112:10). Together they picture the despair of those shut out.

decisions.choice: there: outside the shut door
decisions.reason: The word points back to the place outside the house (13:25).

decisions.choice: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom: the fathers of Israel at God's feast
decisions.reason: The hearers expected to share the kingdom with the ancestors of their people. Instead they see them inside while they are outside (13:29; 16:22-23).

decisions.choice: You will weep there ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the hearers the subject, which the context makes clear.

decisions.choice: in anger and pain
decisions.reason: Readable explains what grinding the teeth shows.

decisions.choice: "울음과 이를 가는 일" (L), "울며 이를 갈 것이다" (B, R), after the "when" clause at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Matthew 8:12; Korean puts the time clause first, so Balanced and Readable end with the weeping, and Literal brackets the words that tie the clause back.

source.text: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ νότου καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And they will come from east and west and from north and south and will recline in the kingdom of God.

en.L: And they will come from east and west and from north and south, and will recline [at table] in the kingdom of God.
en.B: And others will arrive from east and west, from north and south, and sit down to eat in the kingdom of God.
en.R: People will come from all over the world, from the east, west, north, and south. They will sit down and eat together in the kingdom of God.

es.L: Y vendrán del oriente y del occidente, y del norte y del sur, y se reclinarán [a la mesa] en el reino de Dios.
es.B: Y llegarán otros del oriente y del occidente, del norte y del sur, y se sentarán a comer en el reino de Dios.
es.R: Vendrá gente de todo el mundo, del este, del oeste, del norte y del sur. Se sentarán a comer juntos en el reino de Dios.

fr.L: Et ils viendront de l’orient et de l’occident, et du nord et du midi, et ils prendront place [à table] dans le royaume de Dieu.
fr.B: D’autres viendront de l’est et de l’ouest, du nord et du sud, et se mettront à table dans le royaume de Dieu.
fr.R: Des gens viendront du monde entier : de l’est, de l’ouest, du nord et du sud. Ils s’assiéront et mangeront ensemble dans le royaume de Dieu.

sw.L: Nao watakuja kutoka mashariki na magharibi, na kutoka kaskazini na kusini, na wataegemea [mezani] katika ufalme wa Mungu.
sw.B: Na wengine watafika kutoka mashariki na magharibi, kutoka kaskazini na kusini, nao watakaa kula karamu katika ufalme wa Mungu.
sw.R: Watu watakuja kutoka pande zote za dunia, kutoka mashariki, magharibi, kaskazini na kusini. Watakaa na kula pamoja katika ufalme wa Mungu.

ko.L: 그리고 [사람들이] 동쪽과 서쪽에서, 북쪽과 남쪽에서 와서, 하나님의 나라에서 [잔치 자리에] 기대어 앉을 것이다.
ko.B: 사람들이 동쪽과 서쪽에서, 북쪽과 남쪽에서 와서, 하나님의 나라에서 잔치 자리에 앉을 것이다.
ko.R: 온 세상 동서남북에서 사람들이 올 것이다. 그들은 하나님의 나라에서 함께 앉아 잔치 음식을 먹을 것이다.

vi.L: Và người ta sẽ đến từ phương đông và phương tây, từ phương bắc và phương nam, và ngả mình [dự tiệc] trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Những người khác sẽ đến từ phương đông và phương tây, từ phương bắc và phương nam, và ngồi dự tiệc trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ đến từ khắp nơi trên thế giới, từ phương đông, phương tây, phương bắc và phương nam. Họ sẽ ngồi ăn tiệc với nhau trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.

decisions.choice: from east and west and from north and south: God gathering his people from every direction
alternatives: from the regions around Israel only
decisions.reason: The prophets and psalms speak of God gathering people from the four directions (Psalm 107:3; Isaiah 43:5-6), and of a feast for all peoples (Isaiah 25:6).

decisions.choice: recline: lie on couches at a feast
decisions.reason: At a formal meal guests reclined at the table. The kingdom is pictured as a great banquet (14:15).

decisions.choice: they: people from all over the world, including those from other nations
decisions.reason: The subject is not named. In contrast with "you" who are thrown out, they come from far away. Luke tells later of the good news going to all nations (24:47).

decisions.choice: others (B); People (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the verb a subject, to make the contrast with "you" clear.

decisions.choice: from all over the world
decisions.reason: Readable says what the four directions mean.

decisions.choice: "[사람들이]" and "[잔치 자리에] 기대어 앉다" (L); "잔치 자리에 앉다" (B); "함께 앉아 잔치 음식을 먹다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Matthew 8:11 and Luke 7:36; reclining is lying at a feast (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "ngả mình [dự tiệc]" (L); "ngồi dự tiệc" (B); "ngồi ăn tiệc" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:29: guests lay on couches at a feast (meaning decision); Literal shows the posture, Balanced and Readable use the ordinary Vietnamese words.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἰσὶν ἔσχατοι οἳ ἔσονται πρῶτοι, καὶ εἰσὶν πρῶτοι οἳ ἔσονται ἔσχατοι.

records.literal_gloss: And look, there are last who will be first, and there are first who will be last.

en.L: And look, there are last who will be first, and there are first who will be last."
en.B: Some who are last now will be first, and some who are first now will be last."
en.R: Some people who are treated as least important now will be most important then. And some who are most important now will be least important then."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, hay últimos que serán primeros, y hay primeros que serán últimos».
es.B: Algunos que ahora son últimos serán primeros, y algunos que ahora son primeros serán últimos».
es.R: Algunas personas que ahora son tratadas como las menos importantes serán entonces las más importantes. Y algunas que ahora son las más importantes serán entonces las menos importantes».

fr.L: Et voici, il y a des derniers qui seront premiers, et il y a des premiers qui seront derniers. »
fr.B: Certains qui sont maintenant les derniers seront les premiers, et certains qui sont maintenant les premiers seront les derniers. »
fr.R: Certaines personnes que l’on considère maintenant comme les moins importantes seront alors les plus importantes. Et certaines qui sont maintenant les plus importantes seront alors les moins importantes. »

sw.L: Na tazameni, kuna wa mwisho ambao watakuwa wa kwanza, na kuna wa kwanza ambao watakuwa wa mwisho."
sw.B: Baadhi ya walio wa mwisho sasa watakuwa wa kwanza, na baadhi ya walio wa kwanza sasa watakuwa wa mwisho."
sw.R: Baadhi ya watu wanaohesabiwa kuwa wadogo kabisa sasa watakuwa wakubwa kabisa wakati huo. Na baadhi ya walio wakubwa sasa watakuwa wadogo kabisa wakati huo."

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 첫째가 될 꼴찌들이 있고, 꼴찌가 될 첫째들이 있다."
ko.B: 지금 꼴찌인 사람들 가운데 첫째가 될 사람들이 있고, 지금 첫째인 사람들 가운데 꼴찌가 될 사람들이 있다."
ko.R: 지금 가장 낮은 사람들 가운데 그때에 가장 높아질 사람들이 있다. 그리고 지금 높은 사람들 가운데 그때에 가장 낮아질 사람들이 있다."

vi.L: Và kìa, có những người sau chót sẽ trở nên đầu tiên, và có những người đầu tiên sẽ trở nên sau chót."
vi.B: Có những người bây giờ đứng sau chót sẽ được đứng đầu, và có những người bây giờ đứng đầu sẽ phải đứng sau chót."
vi.R: Có những người bây giờ bị xem là kém quan trọng nhất, nhưng khi ấy sẽ trở nên quan trọng nhất. Và có những người bây giờ quan trọng nhất, nhưng khi ấy sẽ trở thành kém quan trọng nhất."

decisions.choice: last ... first: God will reverse the places people hold now
decisions.reason: Luke often shows God bringing down the proud and lifting up the humble (1:52-53; 14:11; 18:14). Those who expected to be first may be shut out.

decisions.choice: there are last who ...: some, not all
decisions.reason: The saying speaks of some people, not of every case.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: now ... then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that the reversal is between this life and the kingdom.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}
decisions.reason: Jesus says "look" to the crowd, so Spanish uses the plural command, which takes the plural_you setting; the English "look" has no number.

decisions.choice: "꼴찌" and "첫째" (L, B); "가장 낮은", "가장 높아질" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 10:31; "가운데 ... 사람들이 있다" keeps the point that this is said of some, not all (meaning decision).

source.text: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθάν τινες Φαρισαῖοι λέγοντες αὐτῷ· Ἔξελθε καὶ πορεύου ἐντεῦθεν, ὅτι Ἡρῴδης θέλει σε ἀποκτεῖναι.

records.literal_gloss: In same the hour came some Pharisees saying to him, Go out and go from here, because Herod wants you to kill.

en.L: At that very hour some Pharisees came, saying to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Get out and go from here, because Herod wants to kill {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: At that very time some Pharisees came up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with a warning: "Get away from here and be on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} way, because Herod intends to kill {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.R: Right then some Pharisees came to Jesus. They told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Get out of this area! Herod wants to kill {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

es.L: En esa misma hora se acercaron algunos fariseos, diciéndole: «Sal y vete de aquí, porque Herodes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} quiere matar».
es.B: En ese mismo momento llegaron unos fariseos a advertirle: «Sal de aquí y sigue {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} camino, porque Herodes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} quiere matar».
es.R: En ese momento unos fariseos fueron a ver a Jesús. Le dijeron: «¡Vete de esta región! Herodes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} quiere matar».

fr.L: À cette heure même, quelques Pharisiens s’approchèrent, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disant : « Sors et pars d’ici, car Hérode veut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tuer. »
fr.B: Au même moment, quelques Pharisiens s’approchèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avertir : « Quitte ces lieux et poursuis {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} route, car Hérode a l’intention de {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tuer. »
fr.R: Juste à ce moment-là, des Pharisiens sont venus voir Jésus. Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Quitte cette région ! Hérode veut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tuer. »

sw.L: Katika saa hiyohiyo walikuja Mafarisayo fulani wakimwambia, "Ondoka, ushike njia uende mbali na hapa, kwa maana Herode anataka kukuua."
sw.B: Wakati huohuo baadhi ya Mafarisayo walimjia na onyo: "Ondoka hapa, uendelee na safari {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa sababu Herode anakusudia kukuua."
sw.R: Wakati huo baadhi ya Mafarisayo walikuja kwa Yesu. Wakamwambia, "Ondoka katika eneo hili! Herode anataka kukuua."

ko.L: 바로 그 시간에 바리새파 사람 몇이 다가와서 그분께 말했다. "나가서 여기를 떠나십시오. 헤롯이 선생님을 죽이려고 합니다."
ko.B: 바로 그때에 바리새파 사람 몇이 예수께 와서 말했다. "어서 이곳을 떠나십시오. 헤롯이 선생님을 죽이려고 합니다."
ko.R: 바로 그때 바리새파 사람 몇 명이 예수께 와서 말했다. "이 지방을 떠나십시오! 헤롯이 선생님을 죽이려고 합니다."

vi.L: Ngay giờ ấy, có mấy người Pha-ri-si đến nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Hãy ra đi, rời khỏi đây, vì Hê-rốt muốn giết Thầy."
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, có mấy người Pha-ri-si đến báo cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy hãy rời khỏi đây mà đi nơi khác, vì Hê-rốt định giết Thầy đấy."
vi.R: Ngay lúc đó, có mấy người Pha-ri-si đến gặp Đức Giê-xu. Họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy hãy rời khỏi vùng này đi! Hê-rốt muốn giết Thầy."

decisions.choice: Pharisees: a Jewish movement devoted to keeping the law of Moses in every part of daily life
decisions.reason: They were respected teachers among the people, and often questioned Jesus (5:21; 11:37-54).

decisions.choice: Herod: Herod Antipas, ruler of Galilee and Perea
decisions.reason: This is the son of the Herod of 1:5. He had put John the Baptist to death and wondered who Jesus was (3:19-20; 9:7-9).

decisions.choice: the Pharisees' motive is not stated
alternatives: they were trying to help him
they wanted to frighten him away
decisions.reason: Some Pharisees may have wanted to warn Jesus; others may have wanted him out of their area. Luke does not say.

decisions.choice: with a warning
decisions.reason: Balanced names what their words were.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Names Jesus where the Greek has a pronoun or leaves the subject unstated, so readers can follow who is acting.

decisions.choice: "les Pharisiens", capitalised
decisions.reason: The New Testament term sheet capitalises the names of Jewish groups, as in John and Mark.

decisions.choice: The Pharisees speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 and say "선생님" for "you"
decisions.reason: Their motive is not stated (meaning decision), so they are given the ordinary polite speech to a teacher rather than the hostile plain style.

decisions.choice: the Pharisees call Jesus "Thầy", with no setting span
decisions.reason: Luke does not say why they warn him (meaning decision); "Thầy", the polite word for a teacher, leaves their motive open. Words of address take no deity_pronoun span (style guide).

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Πορευθέντες εἴπατε τῇ ἀλώπεκι ταύτῃ· Ἰδοὺ ἐκβάλλω δαιμόνια καὶ ἰάσεις ἀποτελῶ σήμερον καὶ αὔριον, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ τελειοῦμαι.

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, Having gone say to the fox this, Look, I cast out demons and healings I complete today and tomorrow, and on the third I am completed.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Go and tell that fox, 'Look, I cast out demons and complete healings today and tomorrow, and on the third [day] I am brought to completion.'
en.B: He answered them, "Go and tell that fox: 'Today and tomorrow I cast out demons and carry out cures, and on the third day I finish {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} course.'
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Go and tell that fox Herod, 'Today and tomorrow I am forcing demons out of people and healing the sick. On the third day I will finish {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} work.'

es.L: Y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:díganle|decidle}} a ese zorro: “Mira, echo fuera demonios y realizo curaciones hoy y mañana, y al tercer [día] soy llevado a término”.
es.B: Él les respondió: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:díganle|decidle}} a ese zorro: “Hoy y mañana expulso demonios y realizo curaciones, y al tercer día termino {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} carrera”.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:díganle|decidle}} a ese zorro de Herodes: “Hoy y mañana voy a expulsar demonios de la gente y a sanar a los enfermos. Al tercer día terminaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} obra”.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Allez dire à ce renard : “Voici, je chasse des démons et j’accomplis des guérisons aujourd’hui et demain, et le troisième [jour] je suis mené au but.”
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Allez dire à ce renard : “Aujourd’hui et demain, je chasse des démons et j’accomplis des guérisons, et le troisième jour j’achève {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} course.”
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Allez dire à ce renard d’Hérode : “Aujourd’hui et demain, je fais sortir des démons hors des gens et je guéris les malades. Le troisième jour, je terminerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} travail.”

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Nendeni mkamwambie mbweha huyo, 'Tazama, natoa pepo na kukamilisha maponyo leo na kesho, na [siku] ya tatu ninafikishwa ukamilifu.'
sw.B: Aliwajibu, "Nendeni mkamwambie mbweha huyo, 'Leo na kesho ninatoa pepo na kuponya wagonjwa, na siku ya tatu ninamaliza mwendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.'
sw.R: Yesu aliwaambia, "Nendeni mkamwambie Herode, yule mbweha, 'Leo na kesho ninawatoa watu pepo na kuwaponya wagonjwa. Siku ya tatu nitamaliza kazi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.'

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 저 여우에게 말하여라. '보라, 내가 오늘과 내일 귀신들을 쫓아내고 병 고치는 일을 이루고, 셋째 [날]에는 완성에 이른다.'
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 저 여우에게 전하여라. '나는 오늘과 내일 귀신을 쫓아내고 병을 고친다. 그리고 셋째 날에는 내 길을 다 마친다.'
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "가서 여우 같은 헤롯에게 말하여라. '나는 오늘도 내일도 사람들에게서 귀신을 쫓아내고 아픈 사람들을 고쳐 준다. 그리고 셋째 날에는 내 일을 다 마칠 것이다.'

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Hãy đi nói với con cáo ấy: 'Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đuổi quỷ và hoàn tất việc chữa bệnh hôm nay và ngày mai, và đến ngày thứ ba thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} được hoàn tất.'
vi.B: Ngài trả lời họ: "Hãy đi nói với con cáo ấy: 'Hôm nay và ngày mai, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đuổi quỷ và chữa bệnh, và đến ngày thứ ba {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hoàn tất con đường của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Hãy đi nói với con cáo Hê-rốt ấy: 'Hôm nay và ngày mai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đuổi quỷ ra khỏi người ta và chữa lành người bệnh. Đến ngày thứ ba {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hoàn tất công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

decisions.choice: that fox: a sly, cunning and destructive man
decisions.reason: The fox was a picture of slyness and of destroying what others had built (Ezekiel 13:4; Song of Songs 2:15). Jesus is not afraid of Herod.

decisions.choice: today and tomorrow, and on the third day: a short time already fixed
decisions.reason: The phrase speaks of a short, set time (Hosea 6:2). Jesus will finish his work on his own timetable, not Herod's.

decisions.choice: I am brought to completion: I reach the goal of my work, which points to his death in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring to completion or to the goal. Jesus goes on to speak of a prophet dying in Jerusalem (13:33), and his "completion" there includes his death and being raised (12:50; 18:31-33).

decisions.choice: healings: cures of the sick
decisions.reason: The word means acts of healing.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: I finish my course (B); I will finish my work (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what is completed. Literal keeps the passive.

decisions.choice: Herod
decisions.reason: Readable names the person meant by "fox".

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 13:35; the message for Herod is in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 13:32-35 are one speech.

decisions.choice: ese zorro
decisions.reason: The Greek noun is feminine, but it names Herod as a sly and destructive man (meaning decision m1). Spanish "zorro" carries that sense; "zorra" would be heard as a sexual insult.

decisions.choice: "je suis mené au but"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the passive, as the English does; "mené au but" says what is completed (m3) without the moral sense "parfait" has in French.

decisions.choice: "완성에 이른다" (L); "내 길을 다 마친다" (B); "내 일을 다 마칠 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is passive and points to the goal of his work and his death (meaning decision); Literal keeps the passive sense of being brought to completion, Balanced and Readable say it actively, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "쫓아내다" for casting out demons, as through Mark
decisions.reason: The Korean Mark uses this verb at every level.

decisions.choice: "con cáo"
decisions.reason: In Vietnamese too the fox is the picture of a sly, cunning man ("cáo già"), which is what the meaning decision says; the picture can stay at every level.

decisions.choice: "được hoàn tất" (L); "hoàn tất con đường" (B); "hoàn tất công việc" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the passive "I am brought to completion", whose double sense the meaning decision footnotes; Balanced and Readable say what is completed, as the English does.

source.text: πλὴν δεῖ με σήμερον καὶ αὔριον καὶ τῇ ἐχομένῃ πορεύεσθαι, ὅτι οὐκ ἐνδέχεται προφήτην ἀπολέσθαι ἔξω Ἰερουσαλήμ.

records.literal_gloss: But it is necessary me today and tomorrow and the following to travel, because not it is possible a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.

en.L: But it is necessary for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to travel on today and tomorrow and the following [day], because it is not possible for a prophet to perish outside Jerusalem.
en.B: But I must go on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} way today, tomorrow, and the day after, because it cannot be that a prophet should die anywhere but in Jerusalem.
en.R: But I must keep traveling today, tomorrow, and the next day. After all, a prophet cannot be killed anywhere except in Jerusalem!

es.L: Pero me es necesario caminar hoy y mañana y el [día] siguiente, porque no es posible que un profeta perezca fuera de Jerusalén.
es.B: Pero tengo que seguir {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} camino hoy, mañana y pasado mañana, porque no puede ser que un profeta muera en otro lugar que no sea Jerusalén.
es.R: Pero tengo que seguir viajando hoy, mañana y al día siguiente. ¡Después de todo, a un profeta no lo pueden matar en ningún otro lugar que no sea Jerusalén!

fr.L: Cependant il {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} faut marcher aujourd’hui et demain et le [jour] suivant, car il n’est pas possible qu’un prophète périsse hors de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Mais je dois poursuivre {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} route aujourd’hui, demain et le jour d’après, car il ne se peut pas qu’un prophète meure ailleurs qu’à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Mais je dois continuer à voyager aujourd’hui, demain et le jour suivant. Après tout, un prophète ne peut pas être tué ailleurs qu’à Jérusalem !

sw.L: Lakini imenipasa leo na kesho na [siku] inayofuata kuendelea na safari, kwa sababu haiwezekani nabii aangamie nje ya Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, ni lazima niendelee na safari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} leo, kesho na kesho kutwa, kwa maana haiwezekani nabii afe mahali pengine isipokuwa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Lakini ni lazima niendelee kusafiri leo, kesho na siku inayofuata. Kwani nabii hawezi kuuawa mahali popote isipokuwa Yerusalemu!

ko.L: 그러나 나는 오늘도 내일도 그다음 날도 [길을] 가야 한다. 예언자가 예루살렘 밖에서 목숨을 잃는 것은 있을 수 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 오늘도 내일도 그다음 날도 내 길을 가야 한다. 예언자가 예루살렘 아닌 다른 곳에서 죽을 수는 없기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 오늘도 내일도 그다음 날도 계속 길을 가야 한다. 예언자가 예루살렘이 아닌 곳에서 죽임을 당할 수는 없지 않으냐!

vi.L: Tuy nhiên, hôm nay, ngày mai và ngày kế tiếp, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải tiếp tục đi, vì không thể có chuyện một nhà tiên tri bị chết bên ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Dù vậy, hôm nay, ngày mai và ngày kia, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải tiếp tục lên đường, vì không thể nào có chuyện một nhà tiên tri lại chết ở nơi nào khác ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Nhưng hôm nay, ngày mai và ngày kia, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn phải tiếp tục đi. Xét cho cùng, nhà tiên tri thì không thể bị giết ở đâu khác ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem!

decisions.choice: it is necessary: it is God's plan for Jesus
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word for what must happen to Jesus by God's will (9:22; 17:25; 24:7, 26).

decisions.choice: it is not possible for a prophet to perish outside Jerusalem: bitter irony
alternatives: a rule or law about where prophets die
decisions.reason: Prophets had died elsewhere, John the Baptist among them. Jesus speaks bitterly: Jerusalem is the city that kills the prophets (13:34; 11:47-51; Jeremiah 26:20-23).

decisions.choice: travel: go on with his journey
decisions.reason: Jesus will not hurry away from Herod; he will keep going toward Jerusalem (9:51; 13:22).

decisions.choice: After all
decisions.reason: Readable signals the irony.

decisions.choice: me es necesario, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a span on "for Me". As in Matthew, the Spanish setting goes on stressed pronouns and possessives (mí, él, mi, su), not on the unstressed "me" before a verb. The same in verses 34 and 35.

source.text: Ἰερουσαλὴμ Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα τοὺς προφήτας καὶ λιθοβολοῦσα τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους πρὸς αὐτήν ποσάκις ἠθέλησα ἐπισυνάξαι τὰ τέκνα σου ὃν τρόπον ὄρνις τὴν ἑαυτῆς νοσσιὰν ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας, καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε.

records.literal_gloss: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the one killing the prophets and stoning those sent to her, how often I wanted to gather the children of you in the way a hen the own brood under the wings, and not you were willing.

en.L: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, [you] who kill the prophets and stone those sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children, in the way a hen [gathers] her brood under [her] wings, and you were not willing!
en.B: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! You kill the prophets and stone the messengers sent to you. How many times I wanted to gather your children, the way a hen keeps her young ones under her wings! But you refused.
en.R: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! You kill the prophets. You throw stones at the messengers God sends to you. Many times I wanted to gather your people together and protect them, the way a hen tucks her chicks under her wings. But you would not let {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: ¡Jerusalén, Jerusalén, la que mata a los profetas y apedrea a los enviados a ella! ¡Cuántas veces quise reunir a tus hijos, como la gallina [reúne] a su nidada bajo [sus] alas, y no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}}!
es.B: ¡Jerusalén, Jerusalén! Matas a los profetas y apedreas a los mensajeros que te son enviados. ¡Cuántas veces quise reunir a tus hijos, como la gallina guarda a sus pollitos bajo sus alas! Pero {{plural_you:se negaron|os negasteis}}.
es.R: ¡Jerusalén, Jerusalén! Matas a los profetas. Apedreas a los mensajeros que Dios te envía. Muchas veces quise reunir a tu gente y protegerla, como la gallina protege a sus pollitos bajo sus alas. Pero no me lo {{plural_you:permitieron|permitisteis}}.

fr.L: Jérusalem, Jérusalem, [toi] qui tues les prophètes et qui lapides ceux qui lui sont envoyés ! Combien de fois j’ai voulu rassembler tes enfants, comme une poule [rassemble] sa nichée sous [ses] ailes, et vous n’avez pas voulu !
fr.B: Jérusalem, Jérusalem ! Tu tues les prophètes et tu lapides les messagers qui te sont envoyés. Que de fois j’ai voulu rassembler tes enfants, comme une poule garde ses petits sous ses ailes ! Mais vous n’avez pas voulu.
fr.R: Jérusalem, Jérusalem ! Tu tues les prophètes. Tu jettes des pierres aux messagers que Dieu t’envoie. Souvent, j’ai voulu rassembler tes habitants pour les protéger, comme une poule met ses poussins à l’abri sous ses ailes. Mais vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas laissé faire.

sw.L: Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, unayewaua manabii na kuwapiga mawe waliotumwa kwake! Mara ngapi nilitaka kuwakusanya watoto wako, namna kuku [anavyowakusanya] vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa [yake], nanyi hamkutaka!
sw.B: Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu! Unawaua manabii na kuwapiga mawe wajumbe wanaotumwa kwako. Mara ngapi nilitaka kuwakusanya watoto wako, kama kuku anavyowahifadhi vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake! Lakini mlikataa.
sw.R: Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu! Unawaua manabii. Unawapiga mawe wajumbe ambao Mungu anakutumia. Mara nyingi nilitaka kuwakusanya watu wako na kuwalinda, kama kuku anavyowaficha vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake. Lakini hamkuniruhusu.

ko.L: 예루살렘아, 예루살렘아, 예언자들을 죽이고 자기에게 보내진 사람들을 돌로 치는 [자여]! 암탉이 제 새끼들을 날개 아래에 [모으는] 것처럼, 내가 몇 번이나 너의 자녀들을 모으려고 하였더냐! 그러나 너희는 원하지 않았다.
ko.B: 예루살렘아, 예루살렘아! 너는 예언자들을 죽이고 너에게 보내진 사람들을 돌로 쳐 죽이는구나. 암탉이 병아리들을 날개 아래 품듯이, 내가 몇 번이나 네 자녀들을 모으려고 하였더냐! 그러나 너희는 그것을 원하지 않았다.
ko.R: 예루살렘아, 예루살렘아! 너는 예언자들을 죽인다. 하나님께서 너에게 보내신 사람들을 돌로 쳐 죽인다. 암탉이 병아리들을 날개 아래 감싸 품듯이, 나는 몇 번이나 너의 백성을 모아 보호하려고 하였다. 그러나 너희는 그것을 마다하였다.

vi.L: Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giê-ru-sa-lem, [ngươi là thành] giết các nhà tiên tri và ném đá những người được sai đến với mình! Biết bao lần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã muốn tập hợp con cái ngươi, như gà mái [tập hợp] bầy con mình dưới cánh, mà các ngươi không muốn!
vi.B: Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giê-ru-sa-lem! Ngươi giết các nhà tiên tri và ném đá những người được sai đến với ngươi. Biết bao lần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã muốn quy tụ con cái ngươi lại, như gà mái ấp ủ bầy con dưới cánh! Nhưng các ngươi không muốn.
vi.R: Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giê-ru-sa-lem! Ngươi giết các nhà tiên tri. Ngươi ném đá những sứ giả Đức Chúa Trời sai đến với ngươi. Đã nhiều lần {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn gom dân ngươi lại để che chở họ, như gà mẹ ủ đàn gà con dưới cánh. Nhưng các ngươi không để cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm điều đó.

decisions.choice: your children: the people of Jerusalem
alternatives: only the children of the city
decisions.reason: A city's people were called its children (19:44).

decisions.choice: a hen gathering her brood under her wings: God's care and protection for his people
decisions.reason: The Scriptures picture God sheltering his people under his wings (Deuteronomy 32:11; Ruth 2:12; Psalm 91:4).

decisions.choice: how often I wanted: Jesus speaks of a longing for Jerusalem that goes beyond his own visits
alternatives: only the times Jesus had been in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Luke does not tell of many visits to Jerusalem. Jesus speaks the way God speaks of sending his messengers again and again (2 Chronicles 36:15-16).

decisions.choice: stoning those sent to her: putting God's messengers to death
alternatives: throwing stones to drive them away
decisions.reason: The prophet Zechariah was stoned in the temple court (2 Chronicles 24:20-21). Stoning was the law's punishment for a false prophet (Deuteronomy 13); Jerusalem used it on true ones.

decisions.choice: those sent to her
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks to the city and then of it in the same sentence. Literal keeps that change; Balanced and Readable say "you" throughout.

decisions.choice: God sends; you would not let me
alternatives: those sent; you were not willing
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the sender and says what the city refused.

decisions.choice: your people
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom.

decisions.choice: tus hijos, then a plural verb ({{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}})
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 23:37, Jesus speaks to the city as "you" in the singular and then says "you were not willing" in the plural, turning to its people (meaning decision m1). Spanish keeps both numbers, so the last verb takes the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "vous n’avez pas voulu": "tu" to the city, "vous" for the refusal
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks to Jerusalem in the singular and then says "you were not willing" in the plural, meaning its people. French can show the change that English "you" hides, so every level keeps it.

decisions.choice: watoto wako (singular "you"), then hamkutaka / mlikataa / hamkuniruhusu (plural)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 23:37, Jesus speaks to the city in the singular and then says "you were not willing" in the plural, turning to its people (meaning decision m1). Swahili keeps both numbers in the verb prefixes, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "자기에게 보내진 사람들" (L); "너에게" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek turns from addressing the city to speaking of it ("to her"); Literal keeps the turn with "자기", as the English Literal keeps "to her".

decisions.choice: "자녀들" (L, B); "백성" (R); no gender span
decisions.reason: The children are the people of Jerusalem (meaning decision); "자녀" already includes sons and daughters.

decisions.choice: the city is "ngươi", its people "các ngươi"
decisions.reason: As for the cities in 10:13-15: "ngươi" is the form for a city addressed in a lament or a woe, and the plural "you were not willing" turns to the people as "các ngươi", through 13:35.

source.text: ἰδοὺ ἀφίεται ὑμῖν ὁ οἶκος ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Look, is left to you the house of you.

en.L: Look, your house is left to you.
en.B: Now your house is left to you.
en.R: Now your house is left to you, for you to keep on your own.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:la casa de ustedes|vuestra casa}} {{plural_you:les|os}} es dejada.
es.B: Ahora {{plural_you:la casa de ustedes|vuestra casa}} queda en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} manos.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:la casa de ustedes|vuestra casa}} queda en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} manos, para que la {{plural_you:guarden|guardéis}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} solos.

fr.L: Voici, votre maison vous est laissée.
fr.B: Maintenant, votre maison vous est laissée.
fr.R: Maintenant, votre maison vous est laissée : vous devrez vous en occuper seuls.

sw.L: Tazameni, inaachwa kwenu nyumba yenu.
sw.B: Sasa nyumba yenu imeachwa mikononi mwenu.
sw.R: Sasa nyumba yenu imeachwa mikononi mwenu, muitunze ninyi wenyewe.

ko.L: 보라, 너희의 집이 너희에게 버려진다.
ko.B: 이제 너희 집은 버려진 채 너희에게 남겨졌다.
ko.R: 이제 너희 집은 버려진 채 너희에게 남았다. 너희끼리 지켜야 할 것이다.

vi.L: Kìa, nhà của các ngươi bị bỏ lại cho các ngươi.
vi.B: Giờ đây, nhà của các ngươi bị bỏ lại cho các ngươi.
vi.R: Giờ đây, nhà các ngươi bị bỏ lại cho các ngươi, để các ngươi tự lo lấy.

decisions.choice: your house is left to you: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: your house is left to you desolate, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "desolate", as in Matthew 23:38. The earliest manuscripts of Luke do not have it. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: your house: the temple, or the city and its people
decisions.reason: The house may be the temple, God's house, or Jerusalem itself as the home of its people. Either way, God is leaving it to them without his protection.

decisions.choice: left to you: abandoned by God
decisions.reason: The prophets warned that God would abandon his house (Jeremiah 12:7; 22:5). Jesus later weeps over the city's coming destruction (19:41-44).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: for you to keep on your own
decisions.reason: Readable explains what being "left" means without adding "desolate", the later reading noted in m1.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:la casa de ustedes|vuestra casa}}
decisions.reason: "Su casa" could be read as "his house" or "her house", so the default spells out "la casa de ustedes", with "vuestra casa" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "버려지다" for aphietai at every level
decisions.reason: The word means left and abandoned (meaning decision); Korean "버려지다" keeps both, and Balanced and Readable add "남다" for "left to you".

source.text: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ ἴδητέ με ἕως ἥξει ὅτε εἴπητε· Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: I say then to you, not not you will see me until it will come when you say, Blessed the one coming in name of Lord.

en.L: And I tell you, you will not see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} until [the time] comes when you say, 'Blessed [is] the one who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord.'"
en.B: I tell you, you will not see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} until the time comes when you say, 'Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.'"
en.R: I tell you, you will not see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} until the time when you say, 'May God bless the one who comes in the Lord's name!'"

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: de ningún modo me {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} hasta que llegue [el tiempo] cuando {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}: “Bendito el que viene en [el] nombre del Señor”».
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que no me {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} hasta que llegue el momento en que {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}: “Bendito el que viene en el nombre del Señor”».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que no me {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} hasta el día en que {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}: “¡Que Dios bendiga al que viene en nombre del Señor!”».

fr.L: Et je vous le dis, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez pas jusqu’à ce que vienne [le temps] où vous direz : “Béni [soit] celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur !” »
fr.B: Je vous le dis : vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez pas jusqu’au moment où vous direz : “Béni soit celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur !” »
fr.R: Je vous le dis : vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez pas jusqu’au jour où vous direz : “Que Dieu bénisse celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur !” »

sw.L: Nami nawaambia, hakika hamtaniona mpaka [wakati] utakapofika mtakaposema, 'Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.'"
sw.B: Nawaambia, hamtaniona mpaka wakati utakapofika mtakaposema, 'Amebarikiwa yeye anayekuja kwa jina la Bwana.'"
sw.R: Nawaambia, hamtaniona mpaka siku mtakaposema, 'Mungu ambariki yeye anayekuja kwa jina la Bwana!'"

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 '주님의 이름으로 오시는 분께 복이 있기를!' 하고 말할 [때가] 올 때까지, 너희는 결코 나를 보지 못할 것이다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 '주님의 이름으로 오시는 분께 복이 있기를!' 하고 말할 때가 오기까지, 너희는 결코 나를 보지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 '주님께서 보내셔서 오시는 분께 하나님께서 복을 주시기를!' 하고 말할 때까지, 너희는 나를 보지 못할 것이다."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các ngươi, các ngươi sẽ chẳng thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho đến khi [thời điểm] đến mà các ngươi nói: 'Đáng chúc tụng [thay] Đấng đến trong danh [của] Chúa.'"
vi.B: Ta nói với các ngươi, các ngươi sẽ chẳng thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa cho đến lúc các ngươi nói: 'Chúc tụng Đấng đến trong danh Chúa!'"
vi.R: Ta nói với các ngươi, các ngươi sẽ không thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa cho đến khi các ngươi nói: 'Cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho Đấng đến trong danh Chúa!'"

decisions.choice: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord: Psalm 118:26
decisions.reason: The psalm was sung by pilgrims coming to the temple at the festivals. Where the Greek has "Lord", the Hebrew of the psalm has the divine name, YHWH. The crowd uses these words when Jesus rides into Jerusalem (19:38).

decisions.choice: until the time comes when you say: the day Jerusalem welcomes him
alternatives: only his entry into Jerusalem in 19:38
only his coming at the end of the age
decisions.reason: Jesus may mean his entry into the city, when his followers say these words, or his coming in glory, when the city will welcome him. Luke does not settle it.

decisions.choice: until [the time] comes when: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: until you say, the reading of some manuscripts
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ over the words between "until" and "you say". The sense is the same. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: not ... see me: a strong double negative, "you will certainly not see me"
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two negatives together for emphasis.

decisions.choice: May God bless
decisions.reason: This word for blessed is a prayer that God will bless, not the word of the Beatitudes. Readable makes the prayer clear.

decisions.choice: in the Lord's name
alternatives: in the name of the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable uses a shorter form.

decisions.choice: "주님의 이름으로 오시는 분께 복이 있기를!" (L, B); "주님께서 보내셔서 오시는 분께 하나님께서 복을 주시기를!" (R); "주님" with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Mark 11:9, so the quotation of Psalm 118:26 reads alike; the Greek has kyrios, so it is "주님", not the divine name setting.

decisions.choice: "Đáng chúc tụng [thay] Đấng đến trong danh [của] Chúa" (L); "Chúc tụng Đấng đến trong danh Chúa" (B); "Cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho Đấng đến trong danh Chúa" (R); "Chúa" with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: The same words of Psalm 118:26 as in Mark 11:9 and John 12:13. The Greek has "Lord" where the psalm has the divine name, so it is "Chúa", as the English writes "Lord".
